This file is a merged representation of the entire codebase, combined into a single document by Repomix.
The content has been processed where line numbers have been added.

================================================================
File Summary
================================================================

Purpose:
--------
This file contains a packed representation of the entire repository's contents.
It is designed to be easily consumable by AI systems for analysis, code review,
or other automated processes.

File Format:
------------
The content is organized as follows:
1. This summary section
2. Repository information
3. Directory structure
4. Repository files (if enabled)
5. Multiple file entries, each consisting of:
  a. A separator line (================)
  b. The file path (File: path/to/file)
  c. Another separator line
  d. The full contents of the file
  e. A blank line

Usage Guidelines:
-----------------
- This file should be treated as read-only. Any changes should be made to the
  original repository files, not this packed version.
- When processing this file, use the file path to distinguish
  between different files in the repository.
- Be aware that this file may contain sensitive information. Handle it with
  the same level of security as you would the original repository.

Notes:
------
- Some files may have been excluded based on .gitignore rules and Repomix's configuration
- Binary files are not included in this packed representation. Please refer to the Repository Structure section for a complete list of file paths, including binary files
- Files matching patterns in .gitignore are excluded
- Files matching default ignore patterns are excluded
- Line numbers have been added to the beginning of each line
- Files are sorted by Git change count (files with more changes are at the bottom)

File: css/base.css
================
  1: /*
  2:   Reset, typography, focus styles and the handful of shared component classes.
  3:   Everything sits in a Tailwind layer so utility classes always win.
  4: */
  5: 
  6: @layer base {
  7:   *,
  8:   *::before,
  9:   *::after {
 10:     box-sizing: border-box;
 11:   }
 12: 
 13:   html {
 14:     background-color: var(--colorBackground);
 15:     text-size-adjust: 100%;
 16:     scroll-behavior: smooth;
 17:   }
 18: 
 19:   body {
 20:     margin: 0;
 21:     min-height: 100vh;
 22:     background-color: var(--colorBackground);
 23:     color: var(--colorText);
 24:     font-family: var(--fontBody);
 25:     font-size: var(--textBase);
 26:     line-height: var(--leadingNormal);
 27:     text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
 28:   }
 29: 
 30:   h1,
 31:   h2,
 32:   h3,
 33:   h4,
 34:   h5,
 35:   h6 {
 36:     margin: 0;
 37:     font-family: var(--fontDisplay);
 38:     font-weight: 400;
 39:     line-height: var(--leadingTight);
 40:     letter-spacing: var(--trackingTight);
 41:     text-transform: uppercase;
 42:   }
 43: 
 44:   p,
 45:   ul,
 46:   ol,
 47:   figure,
 48:   blockquote {
 49:     margin: 0;
 50:   }
 51: 
 52:   ul,
 53:   ol {
 54:     padding: 0;
 55:     list-style: none;
 56:   }
 57: 
 58:   a {
 59:     color: var(--colorAccent);
 60:     text-decoration: underline;
 61:     text-underline-offset: 0.2em;
 62:   }
 63: 
 64:   button {
 65:     font: inherit;
 66:     color: inherit;
 67:     cursor: pointer;
 68:   }
 69: 
 70:   code,
 71:   kbd,
 72:   samp,
 73:   pre {
 74:     font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
 75:     font-size: 0.95em;
 76:   }
 77: 
 78:   /* Focus is always visible and never relies on colour alone */
 79:   :focus-visible {
 80:     outline: var(--borderWidth2) solid var(--colorAccent);
 81:     outline-offset: 2px;
 82:   }
 83: 
 84:   ::selection {
 85:     background-color: var(--colorAccent);
 86:     color: var(--colorBackground);
 87:   }
 88: 
 89:   @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
 90:     *,
 91:     *::before,
 92:     *::after {
 93:       animation-duration: 1ms !important;
 94:       animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
 95:       transition-duration: 1ms !important;
 96:       scroll-behavior: auto !important;
 97:     }
 98:   }
 99: }
100: 
101: @layer components {
102:   .skipLink {
103:     position: absolute;
104:     top: var(--space4);
105:     left: -9999px;
106:     z-index: var(--zToast);
107:     padding: var(--space3) var(--space4);
108:     background-color: var(--colorAccent);
109:     color: var(--colorBackground);
110:     font-weight: 600;
111:     text-decoration: none;
112:   }
113: 
114:   .skipLink:focus {
115:     left: var(--space4);
116:   }
117: 
118:   .tokenLabel {
119:     font-family: var(--fontBody);
120:     font-size: var(--textXs);
121:     font-weight: 600;
122:     letter-spacing: var(--trackingWider);
123:     text-transform: uppercase;
124:     color: var(--colorTextMuted);
125:   }
126: }

================
File: css/tokens.css
================
  1: /*
  2:   The Roast Room design tokens.
  3:   Every club colour is a CSS custom property on the document root, so a club
  4:   theme is swapped at runtime by writing to document.documentElement. The values
  5:   below are the Manchester United default.
  6: */
  7: 
  8: :root {
  9:   color-scheme: dark;
 10: 
 11:   /* Club theme tokens */
 12:   --colorPrimary: #DA291C;
 13:   --colorPrimaryContrast: #FFFFFF;
 14:   --colorAccent: #FBE122;
 15:   --colorBackground: #0A0A0A;
 16:   --colorSurface: #141414;
 17:   --colorSurfaceRaised: #1C1C1C;
 18:   --colorLine: #2A2A2A;
 19:   --colorText: #F5F5F5;
 20:   --colorTextMuted: #A0A0A0;
 21: 
 22:   /*
 23:     Contrast checks, measured against --colorBackground unless stated otherwise:
 24:     text on background 18.2 to 1
 25:     textMuted on background 7.6 to 1, so it clears WCAG AA for body copy
 26:     primary on background 4.1 to 1, used for large text, borders and fills only
 27:     primaryContrast on primary 4.9 to 1
 28:     accent on background 15.0 to 1
 29:   */
 30: 
 31:   /* Type families */
 32:   --fontDisplay: 'Anton', 'Arial Narrow', Impact, sans-serif;
 33:   --fontBody: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, system-ui, sans-serif;
 34: 
 35:   /* Type scale, fluid between small phones and wide screens */
 36:   --textXs: clamp(0.75rem, 0.72rem + 0.12vw, 0.8125rem);
 37:   --textSm: clamp(0.875rem, 0.84rem + 0.16vw, 0.9375rem);
 38:   --textBase: clamp(1rem, 0.96rem + 0.2vw, 1.0625rem);
 39:   --textLg: clamp(1.125rem, 1.06rem + 0.32vw, 1.25rem);
 40:   --textXl: clamp(1.25rem, 1.14rem + 0.55vw, 1.5rem);
 41:   --text2xl: clamp(1.5rem, 1.32rem + 0.9vw, 1.875rem);
 42:   --text3xl: clamp(1.875rem, 1.6rem + 1.4vw, 2.5rem);
 43:   --textDisplaySm: clamp(2rem, 1.5rem + 2.5vw, 3rem);
 44:   --textDisplayMd: clamp(2.5rem, 1.7rem + 4vw, 4.5rem);
 45:   --textDisplayLg: clamp(3rem, 1.8rem + 6vw, 7rem);
 46: 
 47:   --leadingTight: 0.95;
 48:   --leadingSnug: 1.15;
 49:   --leadingNormal: 1.55;
 50:   --leadingRelaxed: 1.7;
 51: 
 52:   --trackingTight: -0.02em;
 53:   --trackingNormal: 0em;
 54:   --trackingWide: 0.08em;
 55:   --trackingWider: 0.16em;
 56: 
 57:   /* Spacing scale, one unit is a quarter rem */
 58:   --space1: 0.25rem;
 59:   --space2: 0.5rem;
 60:   --space3: 0.75rem;
 61:   --space4: 1rem;
 62:   --space5: 1.25rem;
 63:   --space6: 1.5rem;
 64:   --space8: 2rem;
 65:   --space10: 2.5rem;
 66:   --space12: 3rem;
 67:   --space16: 4rem;
 68:   --space20: 5rem;
 69:   --space24: 6rem;
 70: 
 71:   /* Radii, kept small for a scoreboard feel */
 72:   --radiusSharp: 2px;
 73:   --radiusSoft: 6px;
 74:   --radiusPill: 999px;
 75: 
 76:   /* Border widths */
 77:   --borderWidth1: 1px;
 78:   --borderWidth2: 2px;
 79:   --borderWidth3: 3px;
 80: 
 81:   /* Shadows, deliberately minimal */
 82:   --shadowFlat: 0 1px 0 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6);
 83:   --shadowRaised: 0 12px 24px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.8);
 84: 
 85:   /* Z index */
 86:   --zBase: 0;
 87:   --zRaised: 10;
 88:   --zOverlay: 100;
 89:   --zToast: 1000;
 90: 
 91:   /* Motion */
 92:   --durationFast: 120ms;
 93:   --durationNormal: 200ms;
 94:   --durationSlow: 320ms;
 95:   --easeStandard: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1);
 96:   --easeOut: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
 97: }
 98: 
 99: /*
100:   Anyone who asks for reduced motion gets near zero durations. Every animation
101:   and transition in the project reads these tokens.
102: */
103: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
104:   :root {
105:     --durationFast: 1ms;
106:     --durationNormal: 1ms;
107:     --durationSlow: 1ms;
108:   }
109: }

================
File: js/pages/landing.js
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Landing page logic.
  3:  * Renders the club picker from the registry, the recent roast ticker and the
  4:  * hero call to action target, all from data files at runtime.
  5:  */
  6: 
  7: import { DEFAULT_CLUB_ID } from '../config.js';
  8: import { getComingSoonClubs, getLiveClubs, loadClub, loadRegistry } from '../registry.js';
  9: import { clear, createElement } from '../utils/dom.js';
 10: 
 11: const liveContainer = document.getElementById('liveClubs');
 12: const comingSoonContainer = document.getElementById('comingSoonClubs');
 13: const tickerSection = document.getElementById('tickerSection');
 14: const tickerTrack = document.getElementById('tickerTrack');
 15: 
 16: /**
 17:  * Point every CTA at the default club from config.
 18:  * @returns {void}
 19:  */
 20: function setCallToActions() {
 21:   const links = document.querySelectorAll('[data-cta-club]');
 22:   for (const link of links) {
 23:     if (link instanceof HTMLAnchorElement) {
 24:       link.href = `./room.html?club=${encodeURIComponent(DEFAULT_CLUB_ID)}`;
 25:     }
 26:   }
 27: }
 28: 
 29: /**
 30:  * Build one live club card linking to its roast room.
 31:  * @param {{ id: string, name: string }} entry Registry entry.
 32:  * @param {number} roastCount Number of publishable roasts in the club.
 33:  * @returns {HTMLAnchorElement}
 34:  */
 35: function renderLiveClub(entry, roastCount) {
 36:   const link = createElement('a', {
 37:     className:
 38:       'block rounded-sharp border border-line bg-surface p-6 no-underline transition-colors duration-fast ease-standard hover:border-primary',
 39:     attrs: { href: `./room.html?club=${encodeURIComponent(entry.id)}` },
 40:   });
 41: 
 42:   link.append(
 43:     createElement('p', {
 44:       className: 'font-display text-2xl uppercase text-text',
 45:       text: entry.name,
 46:     })
 47:   );
 48: 
 49:   link.append(
 50:     createElement('p', {
 51:       className: 'mt-2 text-sm text-textMuted',
 52:       text: roastCount === 1 ? '1 roast ready' : `${roastCount} roasts ready`,
 53:     })
 54:   );
 55: 
 56:   return link;
 57: }
 58: 
 59: /**
 60:  * Build one coming soon card. Not a link and marked disabled for assistive tech.
 61:  * @param {{ name: string }} entry Registry entry.
 62:  * @returns {HTMLElement}
 63:  */
 64: function renderComingSoonClub(entry) {
 65:   const wrap = createElement('div', {
 66:     className: 'rounded-sharp border border-line bg-surface p-4',
 67:     attrs: { 'aria-disabled': 'true' },
 68:     children: [
 69:       createElement('p', {
 70:         className: 'font-display text-lg uppercase text-textMuted',
 71:         text: entry.name,
 72:       }),
 73:       createElement('p', {
 74:         className: 'mt-1 tokenLabel',
 75:         text: 'Coming soon',
 76:       }),
 77:     ],
 78:   });
 79:   return wrap;
 80: }
 81: 
 82: /**
 83:  * Render the ticker with the first six headlines.
 84:  * Duplicates the items once so the CSS translate loop is seamless; only the
 85:  * first copy is exposed to screen readers.
 86:  * @param {Array<{ headline: string, clubShortName: string }>} roasts
 87:  * @returns {void}
 88:  */
 89: function renderTicker(roasts) {
 90:   if (!tickerTrack || !tickerSection) return;
 91: 
 92:   clear(tickerTrack);
 93: 
 94:   if (!Array.isArray(roasts) || roasts.length === 0) {
 95:     tickerSection.classList.add('hidden');
 96:     return;
 97:   }
 98: 
 99:   const items = roasts.slice(0, 6);
100: 
101:   for (const roast of items) {
102:     tickerTrack.append(
103:       createElement('span', {
104:         className: 'whitespace-nowrap text-sm text-textMuted',
105:         text: `${roast.clubShortName}: ${roast.headline}`,
106:       })
107:     );
108:   }
109: 
110:   for (const roast of items) {
111:     tickerTrack.append(
112:       createElement('span', {
113:         className: 'whitespace-nowrap text-sm text-textMuted',
114:         text: `${roast.clubShortName}: ${roast.headline}`,
115:         attrs: { 'aria-hidden': 'true' },
116:       })
117:     );
118:   }
119: 
120:   tickerSection.classList.remove('hidden');
121: }
122: 
123: /**
124:  * Show a friendly error inside the picker when the registry cannot load.
125:  * @param {string} message
126:  * @returns {void}
127:  */
128: function showPickerError(message) {
129:   if (!liveContainer) return;
130:   clear(liveContainer);
131:   liveContainer.append(
132:     createElement('p', {
133:       className: 'text-textMuted',
134:       text: message,
135:     })
136:   );
137: }
138: 
139: /**
140:  * Load the registry and render every section of the page.
141:  * @returns {Promise<void>}
142:  */
143: async function init() {
144:   setCallToActions();
145: 
146:   try {
147:     const registry = await loadRegistry();
148:     const live = getLiveClubs(registry);
149:     const comingSoon = getComingSoonClubs(registry);
150: 
151:     /** @type {Array<{ headline: string, clubShortName: string }>} */
152:     const roastPool = [];
153: 
154:     for (const entry of live) {
155:       try {
156:         const club = await loadClub(entry.id);
157:         if (liveContainer) {
158:           liveContainer.append(renderLiveClub(entry, Array.isArray(club.roasts) ? club.roasts.length : 0));
159:         }
160:         if (Array.isArray(club.roasts)) {
161:           for (const roast of club.roasts) {
162:             roastPool.push({ headline: roast.headline, clubShortName: String(entry.shortName) });
163:           }
164:         }
165:       } catch (error) {
166:         console.warn('[roastRoom] could not load live club', entry.id, error);
167:       }
168:     }
169: 
170:     if (comingSoonContainer) {
171:       for (const entry of comingSoon) {
172:         comingSoonContainer.append(renderComingSoonClub(entry));
173:       }
174:     }
175: 
176:     renderTicker(roastPool);
177:   } catch (error) {
178:     console.warn('[roastRoom] could not load the registry', error);
179:     showPickerError('Could not load the club list. Serve the site over http and reload.');
180:   }
181: }
182: 
183: init();

  1: /**
  2:  * Roast room logic.
  3:  * Reads the club id from the query string, loads the club, wires the category
  4:  * filter and the shuffle bag, and shows roasts on demand with a short reel.
  5:  */
  6: 
  7: import { CLUB_STATUS, DEFAULT_CLUB_ID } from '../config.js';
  8: import { loadClub, loadRegistry } from '../registry.js';
  9: import { applyTheme } from '../theme.js';
 10: import { buildCategoryFilter } from '../ui/categoryFilter.js';
 11: import { createRoastCard } from '../ui/roastCard.js';
 12: import { createShuffleBag } from '../ui/shuffleBag.js';
 13: import { revealRoast } from '../ui/reveal.js';
 14: import { clear, prefersReducedMotion } from '../utils/dom.js';
 15: import { parseRoastHash } from '../utils/links.js';
 16: 
 17: const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
 18: const clubIdParam = params.get('club') || DEFAULT_CLUB_ID;
 19: 
 20: const loadingEl = document.getElementById('loadingState');
 21: const errorEl = document.getElementById('errorState');
 22: const errorMessageEl = document.getElementById('errorMessage');
 23: const roomEl = document.getElementById('roomState');
 24: const filterContainer = document.getElementById('categoryFilter');
 25: const roastButton = document.getElementById('roastButton');
 26: const progressEl = document.getElementById('progress');
 27: const roastContainer = document.getElementById('roastContainer');
 28: const clubBadge = document.getElementById('clubBadge');
 29: const emptyEl = document.getElementById('emptyState');
 30: const liveRegion = document.getElementById('roastLiveRegion');
 31: const pageHeading = document.getElementById('pageHeading');
 32: 
 33: /** @type {Record<string, unknown> | null} */
 34: let club = null;
 35: let selectedCategory = 'all';
 36: /** @type {ReturnType<typeof createShuffleBag> | null} */
 37: let bag = null;
 38: /** @type {Record<string, unknown> | null} */
 39: let currentRoast = null;
 40: let busy = false;
 41: 
 42: function showLoading() {
 43:   if (loadingEl) loadingEl.classList.remove('hidden');
 44:   if (errorEl) errorEl.classList.add('hidden');
 45:   if (roomEl) roomEl.classList.add('hidden');
 46: }
 47: 
 48: /**
 49:  * Show the error state with a friendly message.
 50:  * @param {string} message
 51:  * @returns {void}
 52:  */
 53: function showError(message) {
 54:   if (loadingEl) loadingEl.classList.add('hidden');
 55:   if (roomEl) roomEl.classList.add('hidden');
 56:   if (errorEl) errorEl.classList.remove('hidden');
 57:   if (errorMessageEl) errorMessageEl.textContent = message;
 58:   if (clubBadge) clubBadge.textContent = 'Club unavailable';
 59: }
 60: 
 61: function showRoom() {
 62:   if (loadingEl) loadingEl.classList.add('hidden');
 63:   if (errorEl) errorEl.classList.add('hidden');
 64:   if (roomEl) roomEl.classList.remove('hidden');
 65: }
 66: 
 67: /**
 68:  * Roasts in the current filter.
 69:  * @returns {Array<Record<string, unknown>>}
 70:  */
 71: function getFilteredRoasts() {
 72:   if (!club) return [];
 73:   const roasts = Array.isArray(club.roasts) ? club.roasts : [];
 74:   if (selectedCategory === 'all') return roasts;
 75:   return roasts.filter((roast) => roast.category === selectedCategory);
 76: }
 77: 
 78: /**
 79:  * Update the "Roast N of M" line. Nothing is shown before the first serve or
 80:  * when the current cycle has already served everything once.
 81:  * @returns {void}
 82:  */
 83: function updateProgress() {
 84:   if (!progressEl) return;
 85:   if (!bag || !currentRoast || bag.size() === 0) {
 86:     progressEl.textContent = '';
 87:     return;
 88:   }
 89:   const size = bag.size();
 90:   const remaining = bag.remaining();
 91:   const n = size - remaining;
 92:   if (n <= 0) {
 93:     progressEl.textContent = '';
 94:     return;
 95:   }
 96:   progressEl.textContent = `Roast ${n} of ${size}`;
 97: }
 98: 
 99: /**
100:  * Look up the category metadata for a roast.
101:  * @param {string} id
102:  * @returns {Record<string, unknown> | null}
103:  */
104: function findCategory(id) {
105:   if (!club || !Array.isArray(club.categories)) return null;
106:   return club.categories.find((category) => category && category.id === id) || null;
107: }
108: 
109: /**
110:  * Show a roast in the card area, reveal it, announce it and update the URL hash.
111:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} roast
112:  * @param {{ animate?: boolean }} [options]
113:  * @returns {Promise<void>}
114:  */
115: async function showRoast(roast, options = {}) {
116:   if (!roast || !roastContainer) return;
117: 
118:   const shouldAnimate = options.animate !== false;
119:   currentRoast = roast;
120: 
121:   const category = findCategory(String(roast.category));
122:   const built = createRoastCard(roast, category);
123: 
124:   clear(roastContainer);
125:   roastContainer.append(built.element);
126: 
127:   const base = window.location.pathname + window.location.search;
128:   try {
129:     window.history.replaceState(null, '', `${base}#${encodeURIComponent(String(roast.id))}`);
130:   } catch {
131:     // Ignore history errors, the page still works.
132:   }
133: 
134:   const animate = shouldAnimate && !prefersReducedMotion();
135: 
136:   if (animate) {
137:     const pool = (Array.isArray(club?.roasts) ? club.roasts : [])
138:       .map((entry) => String(entry.headline))
139:       .filter((headline) => headline.length > 0);
140:     await revealRoast({
141:       headlineElement: built.headlineElement,
142:       finalHeadline: String(roast.headline),
143:       reelPool: pool,
144:       hiddenElements: built.hiddenElements,
145:     });
146:   } else {
147:     built.headlineElement.textContent = String(roast.headline);
148:     for (const el of built.hiddenElements) {
149:       el.classList.add('isVisible');
150:     }
151:   }
152: 
153:   if (liveRegion) {
154:     liveRegion.textContent = String(roast.headline);
155:   }
156: 
157:   updateProgress();
158: }
159: 
160: /**
161:  * Rebuild the bag and the filter chips for the current selection.
162:  * @returns {void}
163:  */
164: function rebuildBagAndFilter() {
165:   if (!club) return;
166: 
167:   const filtered = getFilteredRoasts();
168: 
169:   if (bag) {
170:     bag.reset(filtered);
171:   } else {
172:     bag = createShuffleBag(filtered);
173:   }
174: 
175:   if (filterContainer) {
176:     buildCategoryFilter({
177:       container: filterContainer,
178:       categories: Array.isArray(club.categories) ? club.categories : [],
179:       roasts: Array.isArray(club.roasts) ? club.roasts : [],
180:       selectedId: selectedCategory,
181:       onChange: handleFilterChange,
182:     });
183:   }
184: 
185:   const isEmpty = filtered.length === 0;
186:   if (roastButton) roastButton.disabled = isEmpty;
187:   if (emptyEl) emptyEl.classList.toggle('hidden', !isEmpty);
188: 
189:   if (isEmpty) {
190:     clear(roastContainer);
191:     currentRoast = null;
192:     if (progressEl) progressEl.textContent = '';
193:   }
194: }
195: 
196: /**
197:  * Handle a filter chip click. Resets the current roast and the bag.
198:  * @param {string} newId
199:  * @returns {void}
200:  */
201: function handleFilterChange(newId) {
202:   if (busy) return;
203:   selectedCategory = newId;
204:   currentRoast = null;
205:   if (roastContainer) clear(roastContainer);
206:   if (liveRegion) liveRegion.textContent = '';
207:   rebuildBagAndFilter();
208: }
209: 
210: /**
211:  * Handle the Roast them button click.
212:  * @returns {Promise<void>}
213:  */
214: async function handleRoastClick() {
215:   if (busy || !bag) return;
216:   const items = getFilteredRoasts();
217:   if (items.length === 0) return;
218: 
219:   busy = true;
220:   if (roastButton) roastButton.disabled = true;
221: 
222:   try {
223:     const roast = bag.next();
224:     if (roast) {
225:       await showRoast(roast, { animate: true });
226:     }
227:   } finally {
228:     busy = false;
229:     if (roastButton) {
230:       roastButton.disabled = getFilteredRoasts().length === 0;
231:     }
232:   }
233: }
234: 
235: /**
236:  * Boot the page. Reads the club id, loads the club, wires everything up.
237:  * @returns {Promise<void>}
238:  */
239: async function init() {
240:   showLoading();
241: 
242:   try {
243:     const registry = await loadRegistry();
244:     const clubs = Array.isArray(registry.clubs) ? registry.clubs : [];
245:     const entry = clubs.find((candidate) => candidate && candidate.id === clubIdParam);
246: 
247:     if (!entry) {
248:       showError(`That club isn't in the registry. Pick one from the picker instead.`);
249:       return;
250:     }
251: 
252:     if (entry.status !== CLUB_STATUS.LIVE) {
253:       showError(`${entry.name} is coming soon. There isn't a roast room for it yet.`);
254:       return;
255:     }
256: 
257:     club = await loadClub(clubIdParam);
258:     applyTheme(club.theme || {});
259: 
260:     if (clubBadge) clubBadge.textContent = String(club.name || 'Roast Room');
261:     if (pageHeading) pageHeading.textContent = `${club.name || 'Roast Room'} Roast Room`;
262:     document.title = `${club.shortName || club.name || 'Roast Room'} Roast Room | The Roast Room`;
263: 
264:     const hash = parseRoastHash(window.location.hash);
265:     const deepRoast =
266:       hash && Array.isArray(club.roasts)
267:         ? club.roasts.find((roast) => roast && roast.id === hash) || null
268:         : null;
269: 
270:     selectedCategory = 'all';
271:     rebuildBagAndFilter();
272:     showRoom();
273: 
274:     if (deepRoast) {
275:       await showRoast(deepRoast, { animate: false });
276:     }
277: 
278:     if (roastButton) {
279:       roastButton.addEventListener('click', handleRoastClick);
280:     }
281:   } catch (error) {
282:     console.warn('[roastRoom] could not open the roast room', error);
283:     showError('We could not load this club. Please try again in a moment.');
284:   }
285: }
286: 
287: init();

================
File: js/pages/shuffleBag.test.mjs
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Tests for the shuffle bag. Node test runner only, no extra dependencies.
  3:  */
  4: 
  5: import test from 'node:test';
  6: import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
  7: 
  8: import { createShuffleBag } from '../js/ui/shuffleBag.js';
  9: 
 10: /**
 11:  * Deterministic linear congruential generator used for the boundary tests.
 12:  * @param {number} seed
 13:  * @returns {() => number}
 14:  */
 15: function seededRng(seed) {
 16:   let state = seed;
 17:   return function next() {
 18:     state = (state * 1664525 + 1013904223) % 4294967296;
 19:     return state / 4294967296;
 20:   };
 21: }
 22: 
 23: test('empty list returns null', () => {
 24:   const bag = createShuffleBag([]);
 25:   assert.equal(bag.next(), null);
 26:   assert.equal(bag.next(), null);
 27:   assert.equal(bag.size(), 0);
 28:   assert.equal(bag.remaining(), 0);
 29: });
 30: 
 31: test('single item returns that item every time', () => {
 32:   const bag = createShuffleBag(['only']);
 33:   assert.equal(bag.next(), 'only');
 34:   assert.equal(bag.next(), 'only');
 35:   assert.equal(bag.next(), 'only');
 36:   assert.equal(bag.size(), 1);
 37: });
 38: 
 39: test('every item is served exactly once per cycle', () => {
 40:   const items = ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e'];
 41:   const bag = createShuffleBag(items);
 42: 
 43:   const served = [];
 44:   for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i += 1) {
 45:     served.push(bag.next());
 46:   }
 47: 
 48:   assert.equal(served.length, items.length);
 49:   const unique = new Set(served);
 50:   assert.equal(unique.size, items.length);
 51:   for (const item of items) {
 52:     assert.ok(served.includes(item), `item ${item} was not served in the cycle`);
 53:   }
 54: });
 55: 
 56: test('remaining counts down and starts over on the next cycle', () => {
 57:   const items = ['a', 'b', 'c'];
 58:   const bag = createShuffleBag(items);
 59: 
 60:   assert.equal(bag.remaining(), 3);
 61:   bag.next();
 62:   assert.equal(bag.remaining(), 2);
 63:   bag.next();
 64:   assert.equal(bag.remaining(), 1);
 65:   bag.next();
 66:   assert.equal(bag.remaining(), 0);
 67:   bag.next();
 68:   assert.equal(bag.remaining(), 2);
 69: });
 70: 
 71: test('a new cycle does not start with the last item served', () => {
 72:   const items = ['a', 'b'];
 73: 
 74:   for (let seed = 1; seed < 100; seed += 1) {
 75:     const bag = createShuffleBag(items, seededRng(seed));
 76: 
 77:     const first = bag.next();
 78:     const second = bag.next();
 79:     const firstOfSecondCycle = bag.next();
 80: 
 81:     assert.notEqual(
 82:       firstOfSecondCycle,
 83:       second,
 84:       `seed ${seed}: new cycle started with the last served item`
 85:     );
 86:     assert.equal(bag.size(), 2);
 87:     assert.equal(typeof first, 'string');
 88:   }
 89: });
 90: 
 91: test('a new cycle does not start with the last item served even when the bag contains duplicates by value', () => {
 92:   const items = ['a', 'b', 'c'];
 93:   for (let seed = 1; seed < 50; seed += 1) {
 94:     const bag = createShuffleBag(items, seededRng(seed));
 95:     const firstCycle = [bag.next(), bag.next(), bag.next()];
 96:     const firstOfSecondCycle = bag.next();
 97:     assert.notEqual(
 98:       firstOfSecondCycle,
 99:       firstCycle[firstCycle.length - 1],
100:       `seed ${seed}: new cycle started with the last served item`
101:     );
102:   }
103: });
104: 
105: test('reset swaps the items and starts a fresh cycle', () => {
106:   const bag = createShuffleBag(['a', 'b']);
107:   bag.next();
108:   bag.next();
109: 
110:   bag.reset(['x', 'y', 'z']);
111:   assert.equal(bag.size(), 3);
112:   assert.equal(bag.remaining(), 3);
113: 
114:   const served = [bag.next(), bag.next(), bag.next()];
115:   const unique = new Set(served);
116:   assert.equal(unique.size, 3);
117: });
118: 
119: test('reset to an empty list turns next into null', () => {
120:   const bag = createShuffleBag(['a']);
121:   bag.next();
122:   bag.reset([]);
123:   assert.equal(bag.size(), 0);
124:   assert.equal(bag.next(), null);
125: });
126: 
127: test('rng is injectable and is called during the shuffle', () => {
128:   let calls = 0;
129:   const rng = () => {
130:     calls += 1;
131:     return 0.5;
132:   };
133:   const bag = createShuffleBag(['a', 'b', 'c', 'd'], rng);
134:   bag.next();
135:   assert.ok(calls > 0, 'rng should be called during the shuffle');
136: });
137: 
138: test('serving many times across many cycles still serves every item once per cycle', () => {
139:   const items = ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd'];
140:   const bag = createShuffleBag(items);
141: 
142:   for (let cycle = 0; cycle < 5; cycle += 1) {
143:     const served = [];
144:     for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i += 1) {
145:       served.push(bag.next());
146:     }
147:     const unique = new Set(served);
148:     assert.equal(unique.size, items.length, `cycle ${cycle} did not serve every item once`);
149:   }
150: });

================
File: js/ui/categoryFilter.js
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Builds the category filter chips and reports selection changes.
  3:  * Chips whose category has zero roasts are hidden so the user only sees
  4:  * categories that will actually produce a roast.
  5:  */
  6: 
  7: import { clear, createElement } from '../utils/dom.js';
  8: 
  9: /**
 10:  * Build the filter into a container.
 11:  *
 12:  * @param {{
 13:  *   container: HTMLElement,
 14:  *   categories: Array<{ id: string, displayLabel: string, emoji: string }>,
 15:  *   roasts: Array<{ category: string }>,
 16:  *   selectedId: string,
 17:  *   onChange: (id: string) => void
 18:  * }} options
 19:  * @returns {void}
 20:  */
 21: export function buildCategoryFilter(options) {
 22:   const { container, categories, roasts, selectedId, onChange } = options;
 23: 
 24:   if (!container) return;
 25: 
 26:   clear(container);
 27: 
 28:   const list = Array.isArray(roasts) ? roasts : [];
 29: 
 30:   /** @type {Map<string, number>} */
 31:   const counts = new Map();
 32:   for (const roast of list) {
 33:     const key = String(roast.category);
 34:     counts.set(key, (counts.get(key) || 0) + 1);
 35:   }
 36: 
 37:   const group = createElement('div', {
 38:     className: 'flex flex-wrap gap-2',
 39:     attrs: {
 40:       role: 'group',
 41:       'aria-label': 'Roast category filter',
 42:     },
 43:   });
 44: 
 45:   if (list.length > 0) {
 46:     group.append(
 47:       createChip({
 48:         id: 'all',
 49:         label: 'All',
 50:         count: list.length,
 51:         selected: selectedId === 'all',
 52:         onClick: () => onChange('all'),
 53:       })
 54:     );
 55:   }
 56: 
 57:   if (Array.isArray(categories)) {
 58:     for (const category of categories) {
 59:       const count = counts.get(category.id) || 0;
 60:       if (count === 0) continue;
 61:       group.append(
 62:         createChip({
 63:           id: category.id,
 64:           label: category.displayLabel,
 65:           emoji: category.emoji,
 66:           count,
 67:           selected: selectedId === category.id,
 68:           onClick: () => onChange(category.id),
 69:         })
 70:       );
 71:     }
 72:   }
 73: 
 74:   container.append(group);
 75: }
 76: 
 77: /**
 78:  * Build a single filter chip.
 79:  *
 80:  * @param {{
 81:  *   id: string,
 82:  *   label: string,
 83:  *   emoji?: string,
 84:  *   count: number,
 85:  *   selected: boolean,
 86:  *   onClick: () => void
 87:  * }} options
 88:  * @returns {HTMLButtonElement}
 89:  */
 90: function createChip(options) {
 91:   const { id, label, emoji, count, selected, onClick } = options;
 92: 
 93:   const button = createElement('button', {
 94:     className: 'categoryChip',
 95:     attrs: {
 96:       type: 'button',
 97:       'aria-pressed': selected ? 'true' : 'false',
 98:       'data-category-id': id,
 99:     },
100:   });
101: 
102:   if (emoji) {
103:     button.append(
104:       createElement('span', {
105:         className: 'mr-1',
106:         text: emoji,
107:         attrs: { 'aria-hidden': 'true' },
108:       })
109:     );
110:   }
111: 
112:   button.append(createElement('span', { text: label }));
113:   button.append(
114:     createElement('span', {
115:       className: 'categoryChipCount',
116:       text: `(${count})`,
117:     })
118:   );
119: 
120:   button.addEventListener('click', onClick);
121: 
122:   return button;
123: }

================
File: js/ui/reveal.js
================
 1: /**
 2:  * Reveal animation for a roast card.
 3:  * Runs a short slot machine style reel on the headline, then fades the facts,
 4:  * receipts and verified line in. Under prefers reduced motion everything is
 5:  * skipped and the roast appears immediately.
 6:  */
 7: 
 8: import { prefersReducedMotion } from '../utils/dom.js';
 9: 
10: const REEL_DURATION_MS = 600;
11: const REEL_INTERVAL_MS = 80;
12: 
13: /**
14:  * Reveal a roast inside an already mounted card.
15:  *
16:  * The headline cycles through random entries from the pool for about 600 ms
17:  * with aria hidden set so screen readers do not narrate the churn. When the
18:  * reel settles, the final headline is written, aria hidden is removed, and the
19:  * hidden elements are shown by adding the isVisible class.
20:  *
21:  * @param {{
22:  *   headlineElement: HTMLElement,
23:  *   finalHeadline: string,
24:  *   reelPool: string[],
25:  *   hiddenElements: HTMLElement[]
26:  * }} options
27:  * @returns {Promise<void>}
28:  */
29: export async function revealRoast(options) {
30:   const { headlineElement, finalHeadline, reelPool, hiddenElements } = options;
31: 
32:   if (!headlineElement) return;
33: 
34:   const hidden = Array.isArray(hiddenElements) ? hiddenElements.filter(Boolean) : [];
35:   const pool = Array.isArray(reelPool) ? reelPool : [];
36: 
37:   const finish = () => {
38:     headlineElement.textContent = finalHeadline;
39:     for (const el of hidden) {
40:       el.classList.add('isVisible');
41:     }
42:   };
43: 
44:   if (prefersReducedMotion() || pool.length < 2) {
45:     finish();
46:     return;
47:   }
48: 
49:   headlineElement.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
50:   headlineElement.textContent = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
51: 
52:   const start = Date.now();
53: 
54:   await new Promise((resolve) => {
55:     const tick = () => {
56:       const elapsed = Date.now() - start;
57:       if (elapsed >= REEL_DURATION_MS) {
58:         resolve();
59:         return;
60:       }
61:       const pick = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
62:       headlineElement.textContent = pick;
63:       window.setTimeout(tick, REEL_INTERVAL_MS);
64:     };
65:     tick();
66:   });
67: 
68:   headlineElement.removeAttribute('aria-hidden');
69:   finish();
70: }

================
File: js/ui/roastCard.js

  1: /**
  2:  * Builds the DOM for one roast card. Never uses innerHTML with data, so every
  3:  * piece of evidence is inserted as text or as a safe attribute value.
  4:  */
  5: 
  6: import { createElement } from '../utils/dom.js';
  7: 
  8: /**
  9:  * Build a roast card element.
 10:  *
 11:  * The headline is left empty on purpose. The caller decides whether to run the
 12:  * reel and set the final headline, or to set it immediately for a deep link.
 13:  * The facts block, the receipts block and the verified line start hidden and
 14:  * are revealed by the reveal helper.
 15:  *
 16:  * @param {import('../schema.js').Roast} roast Roast data.
 17:  * @param {import('../schema.js').ClubCategory | null} category Category the roast belongs to.
 18:  * @returns {{
 19:  *   element: HTMLElement,
 20:  *   headlineElement: HTMLElement,
 21:  *   hiddenElements: HTMLElement[]
 22:  * }}
 23:  */
 24: export function createRoastCard(roast, category) {
 25:   const card = createElement('article', {
 26:     className: 'roastCard ticketStub',
 27:     attrs: {
 28:       'data-roast-id': roast.id,
 29:       'aria-label': 'Roast',
 30:     },
 31:   });
 32: 
 33:   const categoryLine = createElement('p', {
 34:     className: 'tokenLabel',
 35:     text: category
 36:       ? `${category.emoji}  ${category.displayLabel}`
 37:       : 'Roast',
 38:   });
 39: 
 40:   const jokeLabel = createElement('p', {
 41:     className: 'tokenLabel mt-4',
 42:     text: 'The joke',
 43:   });
 44: 
 45:   const headlineElement = createElement('h2', {
 46:     className: 'roastHeadline mt-2 text-displaySm text-text',
 47:   });
 48: 
 49:   const factsGroup = createElement('div', {
 50:     className: 'revealTarget mt-6',
 51:     attrs: { 'data-reveal-group': 'facts' },
 52:   });
 53:   const factsLabel = createElement('p', { className: 'tokenLabel', text: 'The facts' });
 54:   const factsText = createElement('p', {
 55:     className: 'mt-2 text-base text-text',
 56:     text: roast.explanation,
 57:   });
 58:   factsGroup.append(factsLabel, factsText);
 59: 
 60:   const receiptsGroup = createElement('div', {
 61:     className: 'revealTarget mt-6',
 62:     attrs: { 'data-reveal-group': 'receipts' },
 63:   });
 64:   const receiptsLabel = createElement('p', { className: 'tokenLabel', text: 'The receipts' });
 65:   const receiptsList = createElement('ul', { className: 'mt-3 space-y-3' });
 66: 
 67:   for (const evidence of roast.evidence) {
 68:     const item = createElement('li', {
 69:       className: 'rounded-sharp border border-line bg-surfaceRaised p-3',
 70:     });
 71: 
 72:     const claimEl = createElement('p', {
 73:       className: 'text-sm text-text',
 74:       text: evidence.claim,
 75:     });
 76: 
 77:     const metaEl = createElement('p', {
 78:       className: 'mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-xs text-textMuted',
 79:     });
 80: 
 81:     const periodSpan = createElement('span', { text: `Period ${evidence.period}` });
 82: 
 83:     const sourceLink = createElement('a', {
 84:       className: 'text-accent',
 85:       text: evidence.sourceName,
 86:       attrs: {
 87:         href: evidence.sourceUrl,
 88:         target: '_blank',
 89:         rel: 'noopener noreferrer',
 90:       },
 91:     });
 92: 
 93:     const accessedSpan = createElement('span', {
 94:       text: `Accessed ${evidence.accessedOn}`,
 95:     });
 96: 
 97:     metaEl.append(periodSpan, sourceLink, accessedSpan);
 98:     item.append(claimEl, metaEl);
 99:     receiptsList.append(item);
100:   }
101: 
102:   receiptsGroup.append(receiptsLabel, receiptsList);
103: 
104:   const verifiedEl = createElement('p', {
105:     className: 'revealTarget mt-4 text-xs text-textMuted',
106:     text: `Checked on ${roast.verifiedOn}`,
107:   });
108: 
109:   card.append(categoryLine, jokeLabel, headlineElement, factsGroup, receiptsGroup, verifiedEl);
110: 
111:   return {
112:     element: card,
113:     headlineElement,
114:     hiddenElements: [factsGroup, receiptsGroup, verifiedEl],
115:   };
116: }

================
File: js/ui/shuffleBag.js
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Shuffle bag used by the roast room.
  3:  * Pure logic, no DOM. rng is injectable so tests stay deterministic.
  4:  *
  5:  * Rules:
  6:  * 1. Every item is served exactly once per cycle before any repeat.
  7:  * 2. When a new cycle starts, the first item differs from the last item
  8:  *    served, whenever the bag holds more than one item.
  9:  * 3. An empty list returns null.
 10:  * 4. A single item returns that item every time.
 11:  */
 12: 
 13: /**
 14:  * @typedef {Object} ShuffleBag
 15:  * @property {() => (T | null)} next Return the next item or null when empty.
 16:  * @property {() => number} remaining Items left before the cycle resets.
 17:  * @property {() => number} size Total items in the bag.
 18:  * @property {(items: T[]) => void} reset Replace the items and reset the cycle.
 19:  * @template T
 20:  */
 21: 
 22: /**
 23:  * Create a shuffle bag.
 24:  * @template T
 25:  * @param {T[]} items Items to serve.
 26:  * @param {() => number} [rng] Random function returning a number in [0, 1).
 27:  * @returns {ShuffleBag<T>}
 28:  */
 29: export function createShuffleBag(items, rng = Math.random) {
 30:   const random = typeof rng === 'function' ? rng : Math.random;
 31: 
 32:   /** @type {T[]} */
 33:   let allItems = [];
 34:   /** @type {T[]} */
 35:   let pool = [];
 36:   /** @type {T | null} */
 37:   let lastServed = null;
 38:   let sizeValue = 0;
 39:   let remainingValue = 0;
 40: 
 41:   /**
 42:    * Fisher-Yates shuffle that leaves the input untouched.
 43:    * @param {T[]} list
 44:    * @returns {T[]}
 45:    */
 46:   function shuffle(list) {
 47:     const copy = list.slice();
 48:     for (let i = copy.length - 1; i > 0; i -= 1) {
 49:       const j = Math.floor(random() * (i + 1));
 50:       const temp = copy[i];
 51:       copy[i] = copy[j];
 52:       copy[j] = temp;
 53:     }
 54:     return copy;
 55:   }
 56: 
 57:   /**
 58:    * Refill the pool from the current items, avoiding a repeat of the last
 59:    * served item when there is more than one item.
 60:    * @returns {void}
 61:    */
 62:   function refill() {
 63:     if (sizeValue === 0) {
 64:       pool = [];
 65:       remainingValue = 0;
 66:       return;
 67:     }
 68: 
 69:     const shuffled = shuffle(allItems);
 70: 
 71:     if (sizeValue > 1 && lastServed !== null && shuffled[0] === lastServed) {
 72:       for (let i = 1; i < shuffled.length; i += 1) {
 73:         if (shuffled[i] !== lastServed) {
 74:           const temp = shuffled[0];
 75:           shuffled[0] = shuffled[i];
 76:           shuffled[i] = temp;
 77:           break;
 78:         }
 79:       }
 80:     }
 81: 
 82:     pool = shuffled;
 83:     remainingValue = pool.length;
 84:   }
 85: 
 86:   /**
 87:    * Replace the items and start a fresh cycle.
 88:    * @param {T[]} newItems
 89:    * @returns {void}
 90:    */
 91:   function reset(newItems) {
 92:     allItems = Array.isArray(newItems) ? newItems.slice() : [];
 93:     sizeValue = allItems.length;
 94:     pool = [];
 95:     lastServed = null;
 96:     remainingValue = sizeValue;
 97:   }
 98: 
 99:   /**
100:    * Serve the next item.
101:    * @returns {T | null}
102:    */
103:   function next() {
104:     if (sizeValue === 0) return null;
105: 
106:     if (pool.length === 0) {
107:       refill();
108:     }
109: 
110:     const item = pool.shift();
111:     remainingValue = pool.length;
112:     lastServed = item === undefined ? null : item;
113:     return item === undefined ? null : item;
114:   }
115: 
116:   /**
117:    * How many items are left in the current cycle.
118:    * @returns {number}
119:    */
120:   function remaining() {
121:     return remainingValue;
122:   }
123: 
124:   /**
125:    * Total number of items in the bag.
126:    * @returns {number}
127:    */
128:   function size() {
129:     return sizeValue;
130:   }
131: 
132:   reset(items);
133: 
134:   return { next, remaining, size, reset };
135: }

================
File: js/utils/dom.js
================
 1: /**
 2:  * Small DOM helpers used across the pages.
 3:  * Never touches innerHTML with data, so nothing user visible can inject markup.
 4:  */
 5: 
 6: /**
 7:  * True when the user has asked the operating system to reduce motion.
 8:  * Returns false in environments without a window, so it is safe to call from
 9:  * any browser entry point without guarding.
10:  * @returns {boolean}
11:  */
12: export function prefersReducedMotion() {
13:   if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof window.matchMedia !== 'function') {
14:     return false;
15:   }
16:   return window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
17: }
18: 
19: /**
20:  * Create an element with a class name, text content, attributes and children,
21:  * all set through safe DOM APIs.
22:  * @param {string} tag HTML tag name.
23:  * @param {{
24:  *   className?: string,
25:  *   text?: string | number,
26:  *   attrs?: Record<string, string | number | undefined | null>,
27:  *   children?: Array<Node | string | null | undefined>
28:  * }} [options]
29:  * @returns {HTMLElement}
30:  */
31: export function createElement(tag, options = {}) {
32:   const element = document.createElement(tag);
33: 
34:   if (typeof options.className === 'string' && options.className.length > 0) {
35:     element.className = options.className;
36:   }
37: 
38:   if (options.text !== undefined && options.text !== null) {
39:     element.textContent = String(options.text);
40:   }
41: 
42:   if (options.attrs && typeof options.attrs === 'object') {
43:     for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(options.attrs)) {
44:       if (value === undefined || value === null) continue;
45:       element.setAttribute(key, String(value));
46:     }
47:   }
48: 
49:   if (Array.isArray(options.children)) {
50:     for (const child of options.children) {
51:       if (child === undefined || child === null) continue;
52:       if (child instanceof Node) {
53:         element.append(child);
54:       } else {
55:         element.append(document.createTextNode(String(child)));
56:       }
57:     }
58:   }
59: 
60:   return element;
61: }
62: 
63: /**
64:  * Set the text content of an element, safely coerced to a string.
65:  * @param {Element | null | undefined} element
66:  * @param {string | number | null | undefined} text
67:  * @returns {void}
68:  */
69: export function setText(element, text) {
70:   if (!element) return;
71:   element.textContent = text === undefined || text === null ? '' : String(text);
72: }
73: 
74: /**
75:  * Remove every child of an element.
76:  * @param {Element | null | undefined} element
77:  * @returns {void}
78:  */
79: export function clear(element) {
80:   if (!element) return;
81:   while (element.firstChild) {
82:     element.removeChild(element.firstChild);
83:   }
84: }

================
File: js/utils/links.js
================
 1: /**
 2:  * URL helpers for deep links between pages.
 3:  */
 4: 
 5: /**
 6:  * Build a stable shareable URL for one roast inside one club.
 7:  * @param {string} clubId Club identifier from the registry.
 8:  * @param {string} roastId Roast identifier, unique inside the club.
 9:  * @returns {string} Relative URL with the club query string and the roast hash.
10:  */
11: export function roastUrl(clubId, roastId) {
12:   const safeClub = encodeURIComponent(String(clubId));
13:   const safeRoast = encodeURIComponent(String(roastId));
14:   return `room.html?club=${safeClub}#${safeRoast}`;
15: }
16: 
17: /**
18:  * Read the roast id from a location hash, ignoring a leading #.
19:  * Returns an empty string when the hash is missing or empty.
20:  * @param {string} hash Value such as "#trophies_last_league_title" or "trophies_last_league_title".
21:  * @returns {string} The decoded roast id, or an empty string.
22:  */
23: export function parseRoastHash(hash) {
24:   if (typeof hash !== 'string') return '';
25:   const raw = hash.startsWith('#') ? hash.slice(1) : hash;
26:   if (raw.length === 0) return '';
27:   try {
28:     return decodeURIComponent(raw);
29:   } catch {
30:     return raw;
31:   }
32: }

  1: /**

================
File: js/registry.js
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Loads and caches the club registry and club data files.
  3:  * Fetch based loading is for the browser. Node scripts read the same files with
  4:  * fs instead, so the schema and loaders stay browser oriented while the build
  5:  * gate validates files directly.
  6:  */
  7: 
  8: import { CLUB_STATUS, REGISTRY_PATH } from './config.js';
  9: import { validateClub, validateRegistry, validateRoast } from './schema.js';
 10: 
 11: /**
 12:  * Error raised when a data file cannot be fetched, parsed or validated.
 13:  */
 14: export class DataLoadError extends Error {
 15:   /**
 16:    * @param {string} message Human readable summary.
 17:    * @param {{ code?: string, path?: string, errors?: string[] }} [details]
 18:    */
 19:   constructor(message, details = {}) {
 20:     super(message);
 21:     this.name = 'DataLoadError';
 22:     this.code = details.code || 'dataLoadFailed';
 23:     this.path = details.path || '';
 24:     this.errors = Array.isArray(details.errors) ? details.errors : [];
 25:   }
 26: }
 27: 
 28: const registryCache = new Map();
 29: const clubCache = new Map();
 30: 
 31: /**
 32:  * Resolve a site relative path against the site root. js/ sits one level below
 33:  * the root, so ../<path> from this module lands on the path at the root, which
 34:  * means the request no longer depends on the URL of the page that loaded it.
 35:  * @param {string} sitePath Path relative to the site root, such as data/clubs.json.
 36:  * @returns {string} Absolute URL string for fetch.
 37:  */
 38: function resolveSitePath(sitePath) {
 39:   return new URL(`../${sitePath}`, import.meta.url).href;
 40: }
 41: 
 42: /**
 43:  * Fetch a json document and translate every failure into a DataLoadError.
 44:  * @param {string} url Absolute URL to fetch.
 45:  * @param {string} sitePath Logical path used in error messages.
 46:  * @returns {Promise<unknown>}
 47:  */
 48: async function fetchJson(url, sitePath) {
 49:   let response;
 50: 
 51:   try {
 52:     response = await fetch(url, { headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } });
 53:   } catch (error) {
 54:     throw new DataLoadError(`Could not reach ${sitePath}`, {
 55:       code: 'networkError',
 56:       path: sitePath,
 57:       errors: [describe(error)],
 58:     });
 59:   }
 60: 
 61:   if (!response.ok) {
 62:     throw new DataLoadError(`Request for ${sitePath} failed with status ${response.status}`, {
 63:       code: 'httpError',
 64:       path: sitePath,
 65:       errors: [`status ${response.status}`],
 66:     });
 67:   }
 68: 
 69:   try {
 70:     return await response.json();
 71:   } catch (error) {
 72:     throw new DataLoadError(`${sitePath} is not valid JSON`, {
 73:       code: 'parseError',
 74:       path: sitePath,
 75:       errors: [describe(error)],
 76:     });
 77:   }
 78: }
 79: 
 80: /**
 81:  * Turn an unknown thrown value into a readable string.
 82:  * @param {unknown} error
 83:  * @returns {string}
 84:  */
 85: function describe(error) {
 86:   if (error instanceof Error) return error.message;
 87:   return String(error);
 88: }
 89: 
 90: /**
 91:  * Warn about roasts that were dropped by the loader.
 92:  * @param {Array<{ id: string, reasons: string[] }>} dropped
 93:  * @returns {void}
 94:  */
 95: function warnAboutDroppedRoasts(dropped) {
 96:   if (dropped.length === 0) return;
 97:   if (typeof console === 'undefined' || typeof console.warn !== 'function') return;
 98: 
 99:   dropped.forEach((entry) => {
100:     console.warn(`[roastRoom] dropped roast "${entry.id}": ${entry.reasons.join('; ')}`);
101:   });
102: }
103: 
104: /**
105:  * Load and cache the club registry.
106:  * @param {{ path?: string, reload?: boolean }} [options]
107:  * @returns {Promise<{ version: number, clubs: Array<Record<string, unknown>> }>}
108:  * @throws {DataLoadError} When the registry cannot be fetched, parsed or validated.
109:  */
110: export async function loadRegistry(options = {}) {
111:   const path = options.path || REGISTRY_PATH;
112: 
113:   if (options.reload !== true && registryCache.has(path)) {
114:     return registryCache.get(path);
115:   }
116: 
117:   const data = await fetchJson(resolveSitePath(path), path);
118:   const result = validateRegistry(data);
119: 
120:   if (!result.valid) {
121:     throw new DataLoadError(`The club registry at ${path} is not valid`, {
122:       code: 'invalidRegistry',
123:       path,
124:       errors: result.errors,
125:     });
126:   }
127: 
128:   registryCache.set(path, data);
129:   return data;
130: }
131: 
132: /**
133:  * Load and cache one club data file. Roasts that fail validation, or that are
134:  * not verified, are dropped with a console warning instead of failing the page.
135:  * @param {string} clubId Club identifier from the registry.
136:  * @param {{ path?: string, reload?: boolean }} [options]
137:  * @returns {Promise<Record<string, unknown>>} The club data with only publishable roasts.
138:  * @throws {DataLoadError} When the club is unknown, not live, or its data file is broken.
139:  */
140: export async function loadClub(clubId, options = {}) {
141:   const registry = await loadRegistry(options);
142:   const entry = registry.clubs.find((club) => club && club.id === clubId);
143: 
144:   if (!entry) {
145:     throw new DataLoadError(`Club "${clubId}" is not in the registry`, {
146:       code: 'unknownClub',
147:       errors: [`unknown club id "${clubId}"`],
148:     });
149:   }
150: 
151:   if (entry.status !== CLUB_STATUS.LIVE) {
152:     throw new DataLoadError(`Club "${clubId}" is not live yet`, {
153:       code: 'clubNotLive',
154:       errors: [`status is ${entry.status}`],
155:     });
156:   }
157: 
158:   if (typeof entry.dataFile !== 'string' || entry.dataFile.length === 0) {
159:     throw new DataLoadError(`Club "${clubId}" has no data file`, {
160:       code: 'missingDataFile',
161:       errors: ['dataFile is missing from the registry entry'],
162:     });
163:   }
164: 
165:   if (options.reload !== true && clubCache.has(entry.id)) {
166:     return clubCache.get(entry.id);
167:   }
168: 
169:   const data = await fetchJson(resolveSitePath(entry.dataFile), entry.dataFile);
170: 
171:   // Validate the club shell first. Roasts are checked one by one below so that
172:   // a single bad roast cannot take the whole club offline.
173:   const shell = typeof data === 'object' && data !== null ? { ...data, roasts: [] } : data;
174:   const shellResult = validateClub(shell, {
175:     path: entry.dataFile,
176:     mode: 'data',
177:     clubId: entry.id,
178:   });
179: 
180:   if (!shellResult.valid) {
181:     throw new DataLoadError(`${entry.dataFile} is not a valid club data file`, {
182:       code: 'invalidClubData',
183:       path: entry.dataFile,
184:       errors: shellResult.errors,
185:     });
186:   }
187: 
188:   const categoryIds = Array.isArray(data.categories) ? data.categories.map((category) => category.id) : [];
189:   const roasts = Array.isArray(data.roasts) ? data.roasts : [];
190:   const published = [];
191:   const dropped = [];
192:   const seenIds = [];
193: 
194:   roasts.forEach((roast, index) => {
195:     const roastResult = validateRoast(roast, {
196:       path: `roasts[${index}]`,
197:       clubId: data.id,
198:       categoryIds,
199:       seenIds,
200:     });
201: 
202:     const roastId =
203:       roast && typeof roast === 'object' && typeof roast.id === 'string'
204:         ? roast.id
205:         : `roasts[${index}]`;
206: 
207:     if (roastResult.valid) {
208:       published.push(roast);
209:     } else {
210:       dropped.push({ id: roastId, reasons: roastResult.errors });
211:     }
212: 
213:     if (roast && typeof roast === 'object' && typeof roast.id === 'string') {
214:       seenIds.push(roast.id);
215:     }
216:   });
217: 
218:   warnAboutDroppedRoasts(dropped);
219: 
220:   const club = { ...data, roasts: published };
221:   clubCache.set(entry.id, club);
222:   return club;
223: }
224: 
225: /**
226:  * Filter a registry down to the clubs that are live.
227:  * @param {{ clubs?: Array<Record<string, unknown>> }} registry
228:  * @returns {Array<Record<string, unknown>>}
229:  */
230: export function getLiveClubs(registry) {
231:   return getClubsByStatus(registry, CLUB_STATUS.LIVE);
232: }
233: 
234: /**
235:  * Filter a registry down to the clubs that are coming soon.
236:  * @param {{ clubs?: Array<Record<string, unknown>> }} registry
237:  * @returns {Array<Record<string, unknown>>}
238:  */
239: export function getComingSoonClubs(registry) {
240:   return getClubsByStatus(registry, CLUB_STATUS.COMING_SOON).sort((a, b) =>
241:     String(a.name).localeCompare(String(b.name))
242:   );
243: }
244: 
245: /**
246:  * Shared status filter used by the two exported helpers.
247:  * @param {{ clubs?: Array<Record<string, unknown>> }} registry
248:  * @param {string} status
249:  * @returns {Array<Record<string, unknown>>}
250:  */
251: function getClubsByStatus(registry, status) {
252:   if (!registry || !Array.isArray(registry.clubs)) return [];
253:   return registry.clubs.filter((club) => club && club.status === status);
254: }

================
File: js/schema.js
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Validation for The Roast Room data files.
  3:  * Every exported validator returns { valid, errors } and never throws.
  4:  */
  5: 
  6: import {
  7:   CATEGORY_IDS,
  8:   CLUB_STATUS,
  9:   LIMITS,
 10:   REGISTRY_VERSION,
 11:   ROAST_ID_PATTERN,
 12:   THEME_KEYS,
 13: } from './config.js';
 14: 
 15: /**
 16:  * @typedef {Object} ValidationResult
 17:  * @property {boolean} valid True when no problems were found.
 18:  * @property {string[]} errors Human readable problem descriptions.
 19:  */
 20: 
 21: /**
 22:  * @typedef {Object} Theme
 23:  * @property {string} primary Hex colour used for club identity and primary fills.
 24:  * @property {string} primaryContrast Hex colour that reads well on top of primary.
 25:  * @property {string} accent Hex colour used for highlights.
 26:  * @property {string} background Page background colour.
 27:  * @property {string} surface Card background colour.
 28:  * @property {string} surfaceRaised Raised panel background colour.
 29:  * @property {string} line Border and divider colour.
 30:  * @property {string} text Default text colour.
 31:  * @property {string} textMuted Secondary text colour.
 32:  */
 33: 
 34: /**
 35:  * @typedef {Object} Evidence
 36:  * @property {string} claim Precise factual statement.
 37:  * @property {string} period Season or date the claim refers to, such as 2013/14 or 2021/09/11.
 38:  * @property {string} sourceName Name of the publication or record.
 39:  * @property {string} sourceUrl Absolute URL starting with https.
 40:  * @property {string} accessedOn Date the source was read, formatted YYYY/MM/DD.
 41:  */
 42: 
 43: /**
 44:  * @typedef {Object} Roast
 45:  * @property {string} id Lowercase identifier, unique inside the club.
 46:  * @property {string} clubId Club the roast belongs to.
 47:  * @property {string} category Category id taken from the club categories.
 48:  * @property {string} headline The joke, 90 characters or fewer.
 49:  * @property {string} explanation Factual context, 280 characters or fewer.
 50:  * @property {Evidence[]} evidence One or more sourced facts.
 51:  * @property {boolean} verified True when a human has checked every claim.
 52:  * @property {string} [verifiedOn] Date of verification, formatted YYYY/MM/DD.
 53:  * @property {string[]} [tags] Optional labels.
 54:  */
 55: 
 56: /**
