 59:  * @property {string} displayLabel Label shown in the interface.
 60:  * @property {string} description Short neutral description.
 61:  * @property {string} emoji Single emoji used by the picker.
 62:  */
 63: 
 64: /**
 65:  * @typedef {Object} Club
 66:  * @property {string} id Club identifier.
 67:  * @property {string} name Full club name.
 68:  * @property {string} shortName Short club name.
 69:  * @property {'live' | 'comingSoon'} status Publication status.
 70:  * @property {string} themeKey Key used to tie the club to a theme.
 71:  * @property {string} [dataFile] Path to the club data file, required when live.
 72:  * @property {Theme} [theme] Theme overrides, full in a data file, partial in the registry.
 73:  * @property {ClubCategory[]} [categories] Categories available to the club.
 74:  * @property {Roast[]} [roasts] Roasts belonging to the club.
 75:  */
 76: 
 77: const DATE_PATTERN = /^(\d{4})\/(\d{2})\/(\d{2})$/;
 78: const SEASON_PATTERN = /^\d{4}\/\d{2}$/;
 79: const HEX_COLOR_PATTERN = /^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$/;
 80: 
 81: /**
 82:  * True for a value that is a plain object and not an array.
 83:  * @param {unknown} value
 84:  * @returns {boolean}
 85:  */
 86: function isPlainObject(value) {
 87:   return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
 88: }
 89: 
 90: /**
 91:  * True for a string that contains something other than whitespace.
 92:  * @param {unknown} value
 93:  * @returns {boolean}
 94:  */
 95: function isFilledString(value) {
 96:   return typeof value === 'string' && value.trim().length > 0;
 97: }
 98: 
 99: /**
100:  * True for a calendar date written as YYYY/MM/DD. The date must actually exist,
101:  * so 2024/02/31 and 2023/02/29 are rejected while 2024/02/29 is accepted. The
102:  * check builds a UTC date and confirms the year, month and day round trip
103:  * unchanged.
104:  * @param {unknown} value
105:  * @returns {boolean}
106:  */
107: function isDateString(value) {
108:   if (typeof value !== 'string') return false;
109:   const match = DATE_PATTERN.exec(value);
110:   if (!match) return false;
111:   const year = Number(match[1]);
112:   const month = Number(match[2]);
113:   const day = Number(match[3]);
114:   const date = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day));
115:   return (
116:     date.getUTCFullYear() === year &&
117:     date.getUTCMonth() === month - 1 &&
118:     date.getUTCDate() === day
119:   );
120: }
121: 
122: /**
123:  * True for a season string such as 2013/14 or a full date.
124:  * @param {unknown} value
125:  * @returns {boolean}
126:  */
127: function isPeriodString(value) {
128:   if (typeof value !== 'string') return false;
129:   if (SEASON_PATTERN.test(value)) return true;
130:   return isDateString(value);
131: }
132: 
133: /**
134:  * True for an absolute URL that uses the https scheme.
135:  * @param {unknown} value
136:  * @returns {boolean}
137:  */
138: function isHttpsUrl(value) {
139:   if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value.startsWith('https://')) return false;
140:   try {
141:     const url = new URL(value);
142:     return url.protocol === 'https:';
143:   } catch {
144:     return false;
145:   }
146: }
147: 
148: /**
149:  * Validate a theme object. Unknown keys and non hex colours are reported.
150:  * @param {unknown} theme
151:  * @param {{ path?: string, requireAll?: boolean }} [options]
152:  * @returns {ValidationResult}
153:  */
154: function validateTheme(theme, options = {}) {
155:   const path = options.path || 'theme';
156:   const errors = [];
157: 
158:   if (!isPlainObject(theme)) {
159:     return { valid: false, errors: [`${path} must be an object`] };
160:   }
161: 
162:   Object.keys(theme).forEach((key) => {
163:     if (!THEME_KEYS.includes(key)) {
164:       errors.push(`${path}.${key} is not a known theme token`);
165:       return;
166:     }
167:     if (!HEX_COLOR_PATTERN.test(String(theme[key]))) {
168:       errors.push(`${path}.${key} must be a hex colour such as #1C1C1C`);
169:     }
170:   });
171: 
172:   if (options.requireAll === true) {
173:     THEME_KEYS.forEach((key) => {
174:       if (theme[key] === undefined) {
175:         errors.push(`${path}.${key} is required`);
176:       }
177:     });
178:   }
179: 
180:   return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
181: }
182: 
183: /**
184:  * Validate the evidence array attached to a roast.
185:  * @param {unknown} evidence
186:  * @param {{ path?: string }} [options]
187:  * @returns {ValidationResult}
188:  */
189: export function validateEvidence(evidence, options = {}) {
190:   const path = options.path || 'evidence';
191:   const errors = [];
192: 
193:   try {
194:     if (!Array.isArray(evidence)) {
195:       return { valid: false, errors: [`${path} must be an array`] };
196:     }
197: 
198:     if (evidence.length < LIMITS.evidenceMinItems) {
199:       errors.push(`${path} must contain at least ${LIMITS.evidenceMinItems} item`);
200:     }
201: 
202:     evidence.forEach((item, index) => {
203:       const itemPath = `${path}[${index}]`;
204: 
205:       if (!isPlainObject(item)) {
206:         errors.push(`${itemPath} must be an object`);
207:         return;
208:       }
209:       if (!isFilledString(item.claim)) {
210:         errors.push(`${itemPath}.claim must be a non empty string`);
211:       }
212:       if (!isPeriodString(item.period)) {
213:         errors.push(`${itemPath}.period must be a season such as 2013/14 or a date such as 2021/09/11`);
214:       }
215:       if (!isFilledString(item.sourceName)) {
216:         errors.push(`${itemPath}.sourceName must be a non empty string`);
217:       }
218:       if (!isHttpsUrl(item.sourceUrl)) {
219:         errors.push(`${itemPath}.sourceUrl must be an absolute URL starting with https`);
220:       }
221:       if (!isDateString(item.accessedOn)) {
222:         errors.push(`${itemPath}.accessedOn must use the format YYYY/MM/DD and be a real calendar date`);
223:       }
224:     });
225:   } catch {
226:     errors.push(`${path} could not be validated`);
227:   }
228: 
229:   return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
230: }
231: 
232: /**
233:  * Validate a single roast. A roast that is unverified is reported as invalid
234:  * on purpose, because an unverified roast must never reach the page.
235:  * @param {unknown} roast
236:  * @param {Object} [options]
237:  * @param {string} [options.path] Prefix used in error messages.
238:  * @param {string} [options.clubId] Club the roast is expected to belong to.
239:  * @param {string[]} [options.categoryIds] Categories the club exposes.
240:  * @param {string[]} [options.seenIds] Roast ids already used inside the club.
241:  * @returns {ValidationResult}
242:  */
243: export function validateRoast(roast, options = {}) {
244:   const path = options.path || 'roast';
245:   const errors = [];
246: 
247:   try {
248:     if (!isPlainObject(roast)) {
249:       return { valid: false, errors: [`${path} must be an object`] };
250:     }
251: 
252:     if (typeof roast.id !== 'string' || !ROAST_ID_PATTERN.test(roast.id)) {
253:       errors.push(`${path}.id must use lowercase letters, digits and underscores only`);
254:     } else if (roast.id.length < LIMITS.roastIdMinLength || roast.id.length > LIMITS.roastIdMaxLength) {
255:       errors.push(`${path}.id must be between ${LIMITS.roastIdMinLength} and ${LIMITS.roastIdMaxLength} characters`);
256:     } else if (Array.isArray(options.seenIds) && options.seenIds.includes(roast.id)) {
257:       errors.push(`${path}.id "${roast.id}" is already used in this club`);
258:     }
259: 
260:     if (!isFilledString(roast.clubId)) {
261:       errors.push(`${path}.clubId must be a non empty string`);
262:     } else if (isFilledString(options.clubId) && roast.clubId !== options.clubId) {
263:       errors.push(`${path}.clubId must match the club "${options.clubId}"`);
264:     }
265: 
266:     if (!isFilledString(roast.category)) {
267:       errors.push(`${path}.category must be a non empty string`);
268:     } else if (Array.isArray(options.categoryIds) && !options.categoryIds.includes(roast.category)) {
269:       errors.push(`${path}.category "${roast.category}" is not one of the club categories`);
270:     }
271: 
272:     if (!isFilledString(roast.headline)) {
273:       errors.push(`${path}.headline must be a non empty string`);
274:     } else if (roast.headline.trim().length > LIMITS.headlineMaxLength) {
275:       errors.push(`${path}.headline must be ${LIMITS.headlineMaxLength} characters or fewer`);
276:     }
277: 
278:     if (!isFilledString(roast.explanation)) {
279:       errors.push(`${path}.explanation must be a non empty string`);
280:     } else if (roast.explanation.trim().length > LIMITS.explanationMaxLength) {
281:       errors.push(`${path}.explanation must be ${LIMITS.explanationMaxLength} characters or fewer`);
282:     }
283: 
284:     const evidenceResult = validateEvidence(roast.evidence, { path: `${path}.evidence` });
285:     errors.push(...evidenceResult.errors);
286: 
287:     if (roast.verified !== true) {
288:       errors.push(`${path}.verified must be true before a roast can be published`);
289:     } else if (!isDateString(roast.verifiedOn)) {
290:       errors.push(`${path}.verifiedOn must use the format YYYY/MM/DD when verified is true`);
291:     }
292: 
293:     if (roast.tags !== undefined) {
294:       if (!Array.isArray(roast.tags)) {
295:         errors.push(`${path}.tags must be an array when present`);
296:       } else {
297:         roast.tags.forEach((tag, index) => {
298:           if (!isFilledString(tag)) {
299:             errors.push(`${path}.tags[${index}] must be a non empty string`);
300:           } else if (tag.length > LIMITS.tagMaxLength) {
301:             errors.push(`${path}.tags[${index}] must be ${LIMITS.tagMaxLength} characters or fewer`);
302:           }
303:         });
304:       }
305:     }
306:   } catch {
307:     errors.push(`${path} could not be validated`);
308:   }
309: 
310:   return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
311: }
312: 
313: /**
314:  * Validate a club record. The same function covers two shapes:
315:  * a registry entry, which must carry a dataFile when live, and a club data
316:  * file, which must carry theme, categories and roasts.
317:  * @param {unknown} club
318:  * @param {Object} [options]
319:  * @param {string} [options.path] Prefix used in error messages.
320:  * @param {'auto' | 'registry' | 'data'} [options.mode] Shape to expect.
321:  * @param {string} [options.clubId] Club id the record must match.
322:  * @returns {ValidationResult}
323:  */
324: export function validateClub(club, options = {}) {
325:   const path = options.path || 'club';
326:   const mode = options.mode || 'auto';
327:   const errors = [];
328: 
329:   try {
330:     if (!isPlainObject(club)) {
331:       return { valid: false, errors: [`${path} must be an object`] };
332:     }
333: 
334:     const looksLikeDataFile =
335:       isPlainObject(club.theme) || Array.isArray(club.categories) || Array.isArray(club.roasts);
336:     const isDataFile = mode === 'data' || (mode === 'auto' && looksLikeDataFile);
337: 
338:     if (!isFilledString(club.id)) {
339:       errors.push(`${path}.id must be a non empty string`);
340:     } else if (club.id.length > LIMITS.clubIdMaxLength) {
341:       errors.push(`${path}.id must be ${LIMITS.clubIdMaxLength} characters or fewer`);
342:     } else if (isFilledString(options.clubId) && club.id !== options.clubId) {
343:       errors.push(`${path}.id must match the registry club "${options.clubId}"`);
344:     }
345: 
346:     if (!isFilledString(club.name)) {
347:       errors.push(`${path}.name must be a non empty string`);
348:     }
349:     if (!isFilledString(club.shortName)) {
350:       errors.push(`${path}.shortName must be a non empty string`);
351:     }
352:     if (!isFilledString(club.themeKey)) {
353:       errors.push(`${path}.themeKey must be a non empty string`);
354:     }
355: 
356:     if (club.status !== CLUB_STATUS.LIVE && club.status !== CLUB_STATUS.COMING_SOON) {
357:       errors.push(`${path}.status must be "live" or "comingSoon"`);
358:     }
359: 
360:     if (mode !== 'data' && club.status === CLUB_STATUS.LIVE) {
361:       if (!isFilledString(club.dataFile)) {
362:         errors.push(`${path}.dataFile is required when status is live`);
363:       } else if (!club.dataFile.endsWith('.json')) {
364:         errors.push(`${path}.dataFile must point at a json file`);
365:       }
366:     }
367: 
368:     if (isPlainObject(club.theme)) {
369:       const themeResult = validateTheme(club.theme, {
370:         path: `${path}.theme`,
371:         requireAll: isDataFile,
372:       });
373:       errors.push(...themeResult.errors);
374:     } else if (isDataFile) {
375:       errors.push(`${path}.theme is required in a club data file`);
376:     }
377: 
378:     if (isDataFile) {
379:       const categoryIds = [];
380: 
381:       if (!Array.isArray(club.categories)) {
382:         errors.push(`${path}.categories must be an array`);
383:       } else if (club.categories.length === 0) {
384:         errors.push(`${path}.categories must contain at least one category`);
385:       } else {
386:         club.categories.forEach((category, index) => {
387:           const categoryPath = `${path}.categories[${index}]`;
388: 
389:           if (!isPlainObject(category)) {
390:             errors.push(`${categoryPath} must be an object`);
391:             return;
392:           }
393:           if (!isFilledString(category.id)) {
394:             errors.push(`${categoryPath}.id must be a non empty string`);
395:           } else if (!CATEGORY_IDS.includes(category.id)) {
396:             errors.push(`${categoryPath}.id "${category.id}" is not a known category`);
397:           } else if (categoryIds.includes(category.id)) {
398:             errors.push(`${categoryPath}.id "${category.id}" is a duplicate category`);
399:           } else {
400:             categoryIds.push(category.id);
401:           }
402:           if (!isFilledString(category.displayLabel)) {
403:             errors.push(`${categoryPath}.displayLabel must be a non empty string`);
404:           }
405:           if (!isFilledString(category.description)) {
406:             errors.push(`${categoryPath}.description must be a non empty string`);
407:           }
408:           if (!isFilledString(category.emoji)) {
409:             errors.push(`${categoryPath}.emoji must be a non empty string`);
410:           }
411:         });
412:       }
413: 
414:       if (!Array.isArray(club.roasts)) {
415:         errors.push(`${path}.roasts must be an array`);
416:       } else {
417:         const seenIds = [];
418:         club.roasts.forEach((roast, index) => {
419:           const roastResult = validateRoast(roast, {
420:             path: `${path}.roasts[${index}]`,
421:             clubId: club.id,
422:             categoryIds,
423:             seenIds,
424:           });
425:           errors.push(...roastResult.errors);
426:           if (isPlainObject(roast) && typeof roast.id === 'string') {
427:             seenIds.push(roast.id);
428:           }
429:         });
430:       }
431:     }
432:   } catch {
433:     errors.push(`${path} could not be validated`);
434:   }
435: 
436:   return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
437: }
438: 
439: /**
440:  * Validate the whole club registry.
441:  * @param {unknown} registry
442:  * @returns {ValidationResult}
443:  */
444: export function validateRegistry(registry) {
445:   const errors = [];
446: 
447:   try {
448:     if (!isPlainObject(registry)) {
449:       return { valid: false, errors: ['registry must be an object'] };
450:     }
451: 
452:     if (registry.version !== REGISTRY_VERSION) {
453:       errors.push(`registry.version must be ${REGISTRY_VERSION}`);
454:     }
455: 
456:     if (!Array.isArray(registry.clubs)) {
457:       return { valid: false, errors: [...errors, 'registry.clubs must be an array'] };
458:     }
459: 
460:     if (registry.clubs.length === 0) {
461:       errors.push('registry.clubs must contain at least one club');
462:     }
463: 
464:     const seenIds = [];
465:     let liveCount = 0;
466: 
467:     registry.clubs.forEach((club, index) => {
468:       const clubResult = validateClub(club, {
469:         path: `registry.clubs[${index}]`,
470:         mode: 'registry',
471:       });
472:       errors.push(...clubResult.errors);
473: 
474:       if (!isPlainObject(club)) return;
475: 
476:       if (club.status === CLUB_STATUS.LIVE) {
477:         liveCount += 1;
478:       }
479:       if (typeof club.id === 'string') {
480:         if (seenIds.includes(club.id)) {
481:           errors.push(`registry.clubs[${index}].id "${club.id}" is a duplicate club id`);
482:         }
483:         seenIds.push(club.id);
484:       }
485:     });
486: 
487:     if (liveCount === 0) {
488:       errors.push('registry.clubs must contain at least one live club');
489:     }
490:   } catch {
491:     errors.push('registry could not be validated');
492:   }
493: 
494:   return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
495: }

================
File: js/theme.js
================
 1: /**
 2:  * Applies a club theme to the document by writing CSS custom properties on the
 3:  * root element. Every colour in tailwind.config.js reads these variables, so a
 4:  * single call reskins the whole page.
 5:  */
 6: 
 7: import { THEME_VARIABLES } from './config.js';
 8: 
 9: /**
10:  * Find the browser theme colour meta tag and set it.
11:  * @param {string} [value] Colour to apply. Falls back to the background token.
12:  * @returns {void}
13:  */
14: function updateMetaThemeColor(value) {
15:   if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
16:   const meta = document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]');
17:   if (!meta) return;
18: 
19:   let next = typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : '';
20:   if (next.length === 0) {
21:     next = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--colorBackground').trim();
22:   }
23:   if (next.length > 0) {
24:     meta.setAttribute('content', next);
25:   }
26: }
27: 
28: /**
29:  * Remove every theme custom property from the root element so the defaults in
30:  * css/tokens.css apply again.
31:  * @returns {void}
32:  */
33: function resetThemeProperties() {
34:   if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
35:   const root = document.documentElement;
36:   Object.values(THEME_VARIABLES).forEach((variable) => {
37:     root.style.removeProperty(variable);
38:   });
39: }
40: 
41: /**
42:  * Apply a theme. Every theme custom property is cleared from the root first, so
43:  * a partial theme falls back to the defaults in css/tokens.css for the keys it
44:  * does not set. The provided keys are then applied and the theme colour meta
45:  * tag is updated to match the resulting background.
46:  * @param {Partial<Record<string, string>>} theme Theme keys to apply.
47:  * @returns {void}
48:  */
49: export function applyTheme(theme) {
50:   if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
51:   if (!theme || typeof theme !== 'object') return;
52: 
53:   const root = document.documentElement;
54: 
55:   resetThemeProperties();
56: 
57:   Object.entries(THEME_VARIABLES).forEach(([key, variable]) => {
58:     const value = theme[key];
59:     if (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim().length > 0) {
60:       root.style.setProperty(variable, value.trim());
61:     }
62:   });
63: 
64:   updateMetaThemeColor(theme.background);
65: }
66: 
67: /**
68:  * Remove every inline theme property so the defaults in css/tokens.css apply
69:  * again, and restore the theme colour meta tag.
70:  * @returns {void}
71:  */
72: export function clearTheme() {
73:   if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
74: 
75:   resetThemeProperties();
76:   updateMetaThemeColor();
77: }

================
File: scripts/validate.mjs
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Data gate for The Roast Room.
  3:  * Validates the registry and every club data file, then exits with code 1 when
  4:  * anything is wrong. Run it before every deploy.
  5:  */
  6: 
  7: import { readFile, readdir } from 'node:fs/promises';
  8: import { join, resolve } from 'node:path';
  9: import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
 10: 
 11: import { CLUB_STATUS, CLUBS_DIRECTORY, REGISTRY_PATH } from '../js/config.js';
 12: import { validateClub, validateRegistry } from '../js/schema.js';
 13: 
 14: const rootDirectory = resolve(fileURLToPath(new URL('..', import.meta.url)));
 15: 
 16: /**
 17:  * Turn an unknown thrown value into a readable string.
 18:  * @param {unknown} error
 19:  * @returns {string}
 20:  */
 21: function describeError(error) {
 22:   if (error instanceof Error) return error.message;
 23:   return String(error);
 24: }
 25: 
 26: /**
 27:  * Read and parse a json file relative to the project root.
 28:  * @param {string} relativePath
 29:  * @returns {Promise<unknown>}
 30:  */
 31: async function readJsonFile(relativePath) {
 32:   const absolutePath = join(rootDirectory, relativePath);
 33:   const text = await readFile(absolutePath, 'utf8');
 34:   return JSON.parse(text);
 35: }
 36: 
 37: /**
 38:  * Run every check and collect problems. The process exit code is set by the caller.
 39:  * @returns {Promise<number>} Number of problems found.
 40:  */
 41: async function main() {
 42:   const problems = [];
 43: 
 44:   let registry;
 45:   try {
 46:     registry = await readJsonFile(REGISTRY_PATH);
 47:   } catch (error) {
 48:     console.error(`Could not read ${REGISTRY_PATH}: ${describeError(error)}`);
 49:     return 1;
 50:   }
 51: 
 52:   const registryResult = validateRegistry(registry);
 53:   problems.push(...registryResult.errors);
 54: 
 55:   const clubs = registry && Array.isArray(registry.clubs) ? registry.clubs : [];
 56:   const referencedFiles = new Set();
 57: 
 58:   // Collect every data file that ANY registry club references, whatever its
 59:   // status. A live club must have a readable, valid file. A coming soon club
 60:   // may declare a file that does not exist yet, but the file is validated in
 61:   // exactly the same way as a live club file when it does exist.
 62:   for (const club of clubs) {
 63:     if (!club) continue;
 64:     if (typeof club.dataFile !== 'string' || club.dataFile.length === 0) continue;
 65: 
 66:     referencedFiles.add(club.dataFile);
 67: 
 68:     let data;
 69:     try {
 70:       data = await readJsonFile(club.dataFile);
 71:     } catch (error) {
 72:         const fileIsMissing = error && error.code === 'ENOENT';
 73:         if (club.status === CLUB_STATUS.LIVE || !fileIsMissing) {
 74:           problems.push(`${club.dataFile} could not be read: ${describeError(error)}`);
 75:         }
 76:         continue;
 77:       }
 78: 
 79:     const clubResult = validateClub(data, {
 80:       path: club.dataFile,
 81:       mode: 'data',
 82:       clubId: club.id,
 83:     });
 84:     problems.push(...clubResult.errors);
 85: 
 86:     if (data && typeof data === 'object' && data.themeKey !== club.themeKey) {
 87:       problems.push(`${club.dataFile}.themeKey must match the registry themeKey "${club.themeKey}"`);
 88:     }
 89:   }
 90: 
 91:   let files = [];
 92:   try {
 93:     files = await readdir(join(rootDirectory, CLUBS_DIRECTORY));
 94:   } catch (error) {
 95:     problems.push(`${CLUBS_DIRECTORY} could not be read: ${describeError(error)}`);
 96:   }
 97: 
 98:   // Orphan check. Every file in the clubs folder must be referenced by at
 99:   // least one registry entry, whatever the status of that entry.
100:   for (const file of files) {
101:     if (!file.endsWith('.json')) continue;
102:     const relativePath = `${CLUBS_DIRECTORY}/${file}`;
103:     if (!referencedFiles.has(relativePath)) {
104:       problems.push(`${relativePath} is not referenced by any club in the registry`);
105:     }
106:   }
107: 
108:   if (problems.length > 0) {
109:     console.error(`Data validation failed with ${problems.length} problem(s):`);
110:     for (const problem of problems) {
111:       console.error(`  ${problem}`);
112:     }
113:     return problems.length;
114:   }
115: 
116:   console.log(
117:     `Data validation passed. ${clubs.length} club(s) and ${referencedFiles.size} data file reference(s) checked.`
118:   );
119:   return 0;
120: }
121: 
122: const problemCount = await main();
123: 
124: if (problemCount > 0) {
125:   process.exitCode = 1;
126: }

  1: /**
  2:  * Schema tests for The Roast Room. Run with node --test.
  3:  * Every fixture used here is FAKE and lives in tests/fixtures.
  4:  */
  5: 
  6: import test from 'node:test';
  7: import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
  8: 
  9: import { validateClub, validateEvidence, validateRegistry, validateRoast } from '../js/schema.js';
 10: import { fakeClubData, fakeRegistry, fakeRoast } from './fixtures/fakeData.mjs';
 11: 
 12: /**
 13:  * Deep clone a fixture and apply a patch, so no test mutates shared data.
 14:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} patch
 15:  * @returns {Record<string, unknown>}
 16:  */
 17: function roastWith(patch) {
 18:   return { ...structuredClone(fakeRoast), ...patch };
 19: }
 20: 
 21: test('a valid roast passes validation', () => {
 22:   const result = validateRoast(structuredClone(fakeRoast));
 23:   assert.equal(result.valid, true, result.errors.join(', '));
 24:   assert.deepEqual(result.errors, []);
 25: });
 26: 
 27: test('a valid evidence array passes validation', () => {
 28:   const result = validateEvidence(structuredClone(fakeRoast).evidence);
 29:   assert.equal(result.valid, true);
 30: });
 31: 
 32: test('a roast without an id fails', () => {
 33:   const roast = structuredClone(fakeRoast);
 34:   delete roast.id;
 35:   const result = validateRoast(roast);
 36:   assert.equal(result.valid, false);
 37:   assert.ok(result.errors.some((error) => error.includes('id')));
 38: });
 39: 
 40: test('a roast id with uppercase letters fails', () => {
 41:   const result = validateRoast(roastWith({ id: 'Fake_Roast' }));
 42:   assert.equal(result.valid, false);

 44: });

218:   const result = validateRegistry(registry);
219:   assert.equal(result.valid, false);
220:   assert.ok(result.errors.some((error) => error.includes('at least one live club')));
221: });
222: 
223: test('validators never throw on unexpected input', () => {
224:   const values = [undefined, null, 0, 'text', [], true];
225: 
226:   for (const value of values) {
227:     assert.doesNotThrow(() => validateRoast(value));
228:     assert.doesNotThrow(() => validateEvidence(value));
229:     assert.doesNotThrow(() => validateClub(value));
230:     assert.doesNotThrow(() => validateRegistry(value));
231:     assert.equal(validateRoast(value).valid, false);
232:     assert.equal(validateRegistry(value).valid, false);
233:   }
234: });

271:       <section aria-labelledby="clubsHeading" class="mb-12">
272:         <h2 id="clubsHeading" class="text-2xl text-text">Clubs</h2>
273:         <p class="mt-2 max-w-2xl text-sm text-textMuted">
274:           Read from data/clubs.json through the real registry module. The registry is the
275:           single source of truth for which clubs exist.
276:         </p>
277:         <p id="registryStatus" role="status" class="mt-3 text-sm text-accent">
278:           Loading the club registry.
279:         </p>
280: 
281:         <div class="mt-4 grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-2">
282:           <div>
283:             <h3 class="tokenLabel">Live</h3>
284:             <ul id="liveClubs" class="mt-3 space-y-3"></ul>
285:           </div>
286:           <div>
287:             <h3 class="tokenLabel">Coming soon</h3>
288:             <ul id="comingSoonClubs" class="mt-3 space-y-3"></ul>
289:           </div>

293: 
294:     <footer class="border-t border-line bg-surface">
295:       <div class="mx-auto max-w-5xl px-4 py-10">
296:         <p class="text-sm text-textMuted">
297:           The Roast Room, stage 1 foundations. Built by Fritt. Every claim on the finished
298:           site must be sourced, dated and verified before it can be published.
299:         </p>
300:       </div>
301:     </footer>
302: 
303:     <script type="module">
304:       import { getComingSoonClubs, getLiveClubs, loadClub, loadRegistry } from './js/registry.js';
305:       import { applyTheme } from './js/theme.js';
306: 
307:       const registryStatus = document.getElementById('registryStatus');
308:       const liveClubsList = document.getElementById('liveClubs');
309:       const comingSoonClubsList = document.getElementById('comingSoonClubs');
310:       const themeButton = document.getElementById('themeToggle');
311:       const themeName = document.getElementById('currentTheme');
312:       const overridesEl = document.getElementById('themeOverrides');
313:       const tokenValues = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-token]'));
314: 
315:       const themeCycle = [];
316:       let themeIndex = 0;
317: 
318:       /**
319:        * Read the live value of every colour token and print it under the swatch.
320:        * @returns {void}
321:        */
322:       function refreshTokenValues() {
323:         const styles = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
324: 
325:         for (const element of tokenValues) {
326:           const variable = element.getAttribute('data-token');
327:           const value = styles.getPropertyValue(variable).trim();
328:           element.textContent = value || 'not set';
329:         }
330:       }
331: 
332:       /**
333:        * Print which tokens the currently applied theme overrides. Because
334:        * applyTheme clears every property before applying a new theme, this list
335:        * is exactly the set of keys in the active theme object.
336:        * @returns {void}
337:        */
338:       function updateOverrideLine() {
339:         if (!overridesEl) return;
340: 
341:         if (themeCycle.length === 0) {
342:           overridesEl.textContent = '';
343:           return;
344:         }
345: 
346:         const current = themeCycle[themeIndex];
347:         const keys = current.theme ? Object.keys(current.theme) : [];
348:         const list = keys.length > 0 ? keys.join(', ') : 'none';
349:         overridesEl.textContent = `Tokens currently overridden by ${current.label}: ${list}`;
350:       }
351: 
352:       /**
353:        * Build one club card for the registry lists.
354:        * @param {Record<string, unknown>} club
355:        * @returns {HTMLLIElement}
356:        */
357:       function createClubItem(club) {
358:         const item = document.createElement('li');
359:         item.className = 'rounded-sharp border border-line bg-surface p-4';
360: 
361:         const name = document.createElement('p');
362:         name.className = 'font-display text-xl uppercase text-text';
363:         name.textContent = String(club.name);
364: 
365:         const meta = document.createElement('p');
366:         meta.className = 'mt-2 text-sm text-textMuted';
367:         meta.textContent = `id: ${club.id} | status: ${club.status} | themeKey: ${club.themeKey}`;
368: 
369:         item.append(name, meta);
370: 
371:         if (typeof club.dataFile === 'string') {
372:           const file = document.createElement('p');
373:           file.className = 'mt-1 text-xs text-textMuted';
374:           file.textContent = `dataFile: ${club.dataFile}`;
375:           item.append(file);
376:         }
377: 
378:         return item;
379:       }
380: 
381:       /**
382:        * Replace the contents of a list with the given clubs.
383:        * @param {HTMLUListElement} list
384:        * @param {Array<Record<string, unknown>>} clubs
385:        * @returns {void}
386:        */
387:       function renderClubList(list, clubs) {
388:         list.textContent = '';
389:         for (const club of clubs) {
390:           list.append(createClubItem(club));
391:         }
392:       }
393: 
394:       /**
395:        * Load the registry and the live club, then wire up the theme button.
396:        * The cycle is deliberately Manchester United, Arsenal, Manchester United.
397:        * @returns {Promise<void>}
398:        */
399:       async function start() {
400:         try {
401:           const registry = await loadRegistry();
402:           renderClubList(liveClubsList, getLiveClubs(registry));
403:           renderClubList(comingSoonClubsList, getComingSoonClubs(registry));
404:           registryStatus.textContent = `Registry version ${registry.version} loaded with ${registry.clubs.length} clubs.`;
405: 
406:           const liveClub = await loadClub('manutd');
407:           themeCycle.push({ label: liveClub.name, theme: liveClub.theme });
408: 
409:           const comingSoonWithTheme = getComingSoonClubs(registry).filter((club) => club.theme);
410:           for (const club of comingSoonWithTheme) {
411:             themeCycle.push({ label: club.name, theme: club.theme });
412:           }
413: 
414:           themeButton.disabled = themeCycle.length < 2;
415:         } catch (error) {
416:           registryStatus.textContent =
417:             'Could not load the club registry. Serve the site over http, for example with npx serve, then reload. ' +
418:             String(error.message);
419:         }
420: 
421:         refreshTokenValues();
422:         updateOverrideLine();
423:       }
424: 
425:       themeButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
426:         if (themeCycle.length === 0) return;
427: 
428:         themeIndex = (themeIndex + 1) % themeCycle.length;
429:         const next = themeCycle[themeIndex];
430: 
431:         applyTheme(next.theme);
432:         themeName.textContent = next.label;
433:         refreshTokenValues();
434:         updateOverrideLine();
435:       });
436: 
437:       await start();
438:     </script>
439:   </body>
440: </html>

================
File: README.md
================
  1: # The Roast Room
  2: 
  3: The Roast Room is an interactive football banter site. Supporters pick a rival club and
  4: read funny, embarrassing and painful facts about it. Every published roast is backed by
  5: dated evidence that a human has checked.
  6: 
  7: The site launches with Manchester United live. Arsenal, Liverpool, Manchester City,
  8: Chelsea and Tottenham Hotspur are listed as coming soon.
  9: 
 10: It is built by the solo web agency Fritt and doubles as a portfolio piece, so the code is
 11: kept small, readable and easy to extend.
 12: 
 13: ## Project status
 14: 
 15: - **Stage 1 (foundations)**: done. Design tokens, theming, club registry, roast schema,
 16:   validation, developer token preview, documentation.
 17: - **Stage 2 (public pages)**: done. Landing page, club picker, roast generator, shuffle
 18:   bag, reveal animation, deep links, category filter, share ready roast URL helper.
 19: - **Stage 3 (next)**: share cards, suggestions form, branding and polish, deployment.
 20: 
 21: ## Pages
 22: 
 23: | Page | Purpose |
 24: | --- | --- |
 25: | `index.html` | Public landing page. Hero, recent roast ticker, how it works, club picker. |
 26: | `room.html?club=<id>` | Roast generator for one live club. Category filter, shuffle bag, roast card with receipts. |
 27: | `tokens.html` | Developer preview of design tokens and theming. Not linked from public pages. |
 28: 
 29: ## Files added in stage 2
 30: 
 31: ```text
 32: index.html                   Public landing page
 33: room.html                    Roast generator page, opened as room.html?club=manutd
 34: tokens.html                  Developer token preview, moved from stage 1
 35: favicon.svg                  Inline SVG favicon, flame shape in club red and yellow
 36: css/components.css           Shared component styles in Tailwind layers
 37: js/pages/landing.js          Landing page logic
 38: js/pages/room.js             Roast room logic
 39: js/ui/roastCard.js           Roast card DOM builder
 40: js/ui/categoryFilter.js      Category filter chip builder
 41: js/ui/shuffleBag.js          Pure shuffle bag, no DOM
 42: js/ui/reveal.js              Slot machine reel and fade in
 43: js/utils/dom.js              Safe DOM helpers, no innerHTML with data
 44: js/utils/links.js            roastUrl and parseRoastHash
 45: tests/shuffleBag.test.mjs    node:test suite for the shuffle bag
 46: ```
 47: 
 48: ## Requirements
 49: 
 50: - Node 18 or later
 51: - npm
 52: 
 53: The only development dependency is Tailwind CSS, pinned to the 3.4 line.
 54: 
 55: ## Run it locally
 56: 
 57: ```bash
 58: npm install
 59: npm run css
 60: npx serve .
 61: ```
 62: 
 63: Then open the URL that `serve` prints.
 64: 
 65: `fetch` needs an http origin, so opening the HTML files from the file system will not load
 66: the registry. If you would rather not install `serve`, the Python standard library works:
 67: 
 68: ```bash
 69: python3 -m http.server 8000
 70: ```
 71: 
 72: ## Scripts
 73: 
 74: | Script | What it does |
 75: | --- | --- |
 76: | `npm run css` | Compiles `src/input.css` to `dist/styles.css` once |
 77: | `npm run watch` | Compiles the CSS and rebuilds on every change |
 78: | `npm run validate` | Validates the registry and every club data file, exits 1 on any problem |
 79: | `npm test` | Runs the schema and shuffle bag tests with the Node test runner |
 80: 
 81: ## Folder structure
 82: 
 83: ```text
 84: index.html                 Public landing page
 85: room.html                  Roast generator page
 86: tokens.html                Developer token preview page
 87: favicon.svg
 88: package.json
 89: tailwind.config.js
 90: README.md
 91: src/input.css
 92: css/tokens.css
 93: css/base.css
 94: css/components.css
 95: js/config.js
 96: js/schema.js
 97: js/registry.js
 98: js/theme.js
 99: js/pages/landing.js
100: js/pages/room.js
101: js/ui/roastCard.js
102: js/ui/categoryFilter.js
103: js/ui/shuffleBag.js
104: js/ui/reveal.js
105: js/utils/dom.js
106: js/utils/links.js
107: data/clubs.json
108: data/clubs/manutd.json
109: scripts/validate.mjs
110: tests/schema.test.mjs
111: tests/shuffleBag.test.mjs
112: tests/fixtures/
113: dist/
114: ```
115: 
116: ## Deep links
117: 
118: A roast has a stable hash based URL that points at the roast room for its club.
119: 
120: - Landing page: `/index.html`
121: - Roast room for Manchester United: `/room.html?club=manutd`
122: - A specific roast: `/room.html?club=manutd#trophies_last_league_title`
123: 
124: `js/utils/links.js` exports `roastUrl(clubId, roastId)` for building these URLs (this is
125: what share cards will use later) and `parseRoastHash(hash)` for reading them back. When a
126: visitor lands on `room.html` with a hash that matches a live roast, the roast is shown
127: immediately without the reveal animation.
128: 
129: When the visitor presses Roast them, the hash is updated with `history.replaceState` so
130: the URL always points at the visible roast, without pushing a new history entry and
131: without scrolling.
132: 
133: ## Design tokens and theming
134: 
135: Every colour lives in `css/tokens.css` as a CSS custom property on `:root`. The default
136: values are the Manchester United theme. `tailwind.config.js` maps Tailwind colour keys such
137: as `background`, `surface` and `primary` onto those variables, so a club theme swap is a
138: CSS variable swap, not a rebuild.
139: 
140: `applyTheme(theme)` clears every theme property from the root first, then sets the keys you
141: pass, so a partial theme falls back to the defaults for the keys it does not set.
142: `clearTheme()` does the same reset without applying anything. Both keep the `theme-color`
143: meta tag in step.
144: 
145: ## Club registry
146: 
147: `data/clubs.json` is the single source of truth for which clubs exist. `status` is either
148: `live` or `comingSoon`. A live club must have a `dataFile`. A coming soon club may omit
149: `dataFile` or declare one that does not exist yet, but the file is validated the moment it
150: exists.
151: 
152: ## Roast schema
153: 
154: Every roast must satisfy all of the following:
155: 
156: | Field | Rule |
157: | --- | --- |
158: | `id` | Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, unique inside the club |
159: | `clubId` | Must match the club that owns the data file |
160: | `category` | Must exist in that club categories array |
161: | `headline` | The joke, 90 characters or fewer |
162: | `explanation` | Plain factual context, 280 characters or fewer |
163: | `evidence` | At least one item |
164: | `evidence[].claim` | A precise factual statement |
165: | `evidence[].period` | A season such as `2013/14` or a date such as `2021/09/11` |
166: | `evidence[].sourceName` | The publication or record the claim came from |
167: | `evidence[].sourceUrl` | Absolute URL starting with `https` |
168: | `evidence[].accessedOn` | Real calendar date the source was read, formatted `YYYY/MM/DD` |
169: | `verified` | Boolean, and it must be `true` for the roast to be published |
170: | `verifiedOn` | Required when `verified` is true, formatted `YYYY/MM/DD` |
171: | `tags` | Optional array of strings |
172: 
173: Dates are validated against the real calendar, so `2024/02/31` and `2023/02/29` are
174: rejected while `2024/02/29` is accepted.
175: 
176: **FAKE example. This is placeholder data that exists only to show the shape.**
177: 
178: ```json
179: {
180:   "id": "fake_example_roast",
181:   "clubId": "fakeclub",
182:   "category": "trophyDroughts",
183:   "headline": "FAKE headline used to show the schema shape.",
184:   "explanation": "FAKE explanation used to show the schema shape.",
185:   "evidence": [
186:     {
187:       "claim": "FAKE claim used to show the evidence shape.",
188:       "period": "2013/14",
189:       "sourceName": "FAKE Source Name",
190:       "sourceUrl": "https://example.com/fakeSource",
191:       "accessedOn": "2024/01/15"
192:     }
193:   ],
194:   "verified": true,
195:   "verifiedOn": "2024/01/16",
196:   "tags": ["fake"]
197: }
198: ```
199: 
200: ## Content accuracy rules
201: 
202: 1. Never invent a fact, a score, a statistic, a date or a URL.
203: 2. Every claim needs a named source and a live `https` URL.
204: 3. Every claim records the period it refers to.
205: 4. A roast is published only when a human has set `verified` to `true` and dated it.
206: 5. If a fact cannot be sourced, the roast is cut. It is not softened or hedged.
207: 6. Sample and test data is labelled FAKE and is never loaded by the site.
208: 
209: The browser drops invalid roasts and logs a console warning with the roast id and the
210: reasons. The data gate is strict and fails the build.
211: 
212: ## Adding a new club
213: 
214: 1. Add the club to `data/clubs.json` with `id`, `name`, `shortName`, `status` set to
215:    `comingSoon`, `themeKey` and an optional `dataFile`.
216: 2. Create `data/clubs/<clubid>.json` with club metadata, the full theme object, the
217:    categories array and an empty `roasts` array. The file is validated exactly like a live
218:    club file.
219: 3. Run `npm run validate` and `npm test`. When both pass, change the registry status from
220:    `comingSoon` to `live` and run `npm run validate` again.
221: 
222: The orphan rule is strict: every file in `data/clubs` must be referenced by a `dataFile`
223: path on some registry entry, whatever the status of that entry.
224: 
225: ## Accessibility and performance
226: 
227: - Semantic landmarks, a skip link, a `lang` attribute and one `h1` per page
228: - Visible focus rings driven by tokens, never colour alone
229: - Colour contrast checked against WCAG AA
230: - All motion runs through duration tokens and collapses under `prefers-reduced-motion`
231: - The roast reveal animation checks `prefers-reduced-motion` in JavaScript as well as
232:   CSS, so the reel is skipped entirely for users who ask for less motion
233: - The intermediate reel text is `aria hidden`; only the final roast is announced through
234:   a polite live region
235: - Fonts load with `preconnect` and `display=swap`, and every stack has a system fallback
236: - No frameworks, no bundlers and one development dependency
237: 
238: ## Validation and tests
239: 
240: ```bash
241: npm run validate
242: npm test
243: ```
244: 
245: `npm run validate` fails on an invalid roast, a duplicate roast id, an unknown category,
246: an unknown club, a live club with no data file, an unreadable live data file, an invalid
247: data file on a coming soon club that declares one, an orphaned data file that no registry
248: entry references, or a malformed registry. `npm test` runs both the schema tests and the
249: shuffle bag tests with FAKE fixtures in `tests/fixtures/`.

  1: /**
  2:  * Tailwind reads its colour, type, spacing, radius, shadow, z index and motion
  3:  * scales straight from the CSS custom properties in css/tokens.css. That is
  4:  * what lets a club theme swap without a rebuild or a class change.
  5:  */
  6: 
  7: const colors = {
  8:   transparent: 'transparent',
  9:   current: 'currentColor',
 10:   inherit: 'inherit',
 11:   white: '#FFFFFF',
 12:   black: '#000000',
 13:   background: 'var(--colorBackground)',
 14:   surface: 'var(--colorSurface)',
 15:   surfaceRaised: 'var(--colorSurfaceRaised)',
 16:   line: 'var(--colorLine)',
 17:   text: 'var(--colorText)',
 18:   textMuted: 'var(--colorTextMuted)',
 19:   primary: 'var(--colorPrimary)',
 20:   primaryContrast: 'var(--colorPrimaryContrast)',
 21:   accent: 'var(--colorAccent)',
 22: };
 23:
